eng_text: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Ukuze babuyisele izinga lamandla ebebekulo ngaphambili, funeke bahlehle amandla angapha kokudingeka abawafumene ekukhanyeni.
eng_text: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Benza oku ngokukhupha isuntswana lokukhanya elibizwa ngokuba yi "photon".
eng_text: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Oososayensi bayibiza le nkqubo "njengenkqubo ekhuthazwayo yokukhupha iradiyeyshini" ngenxa yokuba ii-atomu zikhutshwa kukuqaqamba kokukhanya, nto leyo ebangela ukuphuma kwe-photon yokukhanye, yaye ukukhanya luhlobo oluthile lweradiyeyshini.
eng_text: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Umfanekiso olandelayo ubonakalisa iiathom eziveza iiphotons. Kakade, Enyanisweni iiphoton zincinci kakhulu kunezo zikulo mfanekiso.
eng_text: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Iiphotons zincinane nangakumbi kunee-atom!
eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Emva kwamakhulu eeyure zokusebenza ekugqibeleni iyatsha intambo kwibhalbhu ibe ke ngoku ibhalbhu yesibane ayisasebenzi.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Kumele kutshinthwe isibane. Kubalulekile ukuba kuqatshelwe xa kutshintshwa isibane.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Okokuqala, i-switch yesibane imele icinywe okanye kwenziwe iintambo zingasebenzi.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Kungenxa yokuba umbane uhamba ungene kwisokethi apho kuhlala khona isinyithi sebhalbhu ingakutshowukha kakhulu ukuba unoyibamba ngaphakathi le sokethi okanye esisinyithi sale bhalbhu ngoku sisekwi sokethi.
eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Elona lungu liphambili kwinkqubo yokujikeleza kwegazi yintliziyo, empompa igazi.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Igazi lisuka entliziyweni ngeetyhubhu ezibizwa ngokuba zii arteries kwaye libuyele entliziyweni kwiityhubhu ezibizwa ngokuba yimithambo. Ezona tyhubhu zincinci zibizwa ngokuba zii-capillaries.
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Amazinyo e-triceratops ngewekwazile ukukrwamza hayi amagqabi odwa kodwa namasebe omeleleyo neengcambhu.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Ezinye iisayentisti zicinga ukuba iTriceratops yatya ii-cycads, ezizintlobo zezityalo ezaziqhelekile eCretaceous.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Ezi zityalo zifana nomthi wesundu onesitshaba samagqabi atsolo natsobhileyo.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: I-Triceratops isenokuba ibisebenzise lamlomo wayo untshontsho ukomelela ukususa amagqabi phambi kokutya isihlahla.
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Ososayensi baxoxa ngelithi ezi zityalo zinobungozi ngoko ke akukholeleki ukuba amagongqongqo idinosa ayezitya, nangona namhlanje uluhlu nezinye izilwanyana njenge sikhwenene (esisizukulwana se dinoza) singazitya izityalo ezimagqabi ayityhefu okanye iziqhamo zazo.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Inganditsala njani igravithi ye lo? Ukuba ubume kumphezulu kwe-Io, unganobunzima obungaphantsi kobakho eMhlabeni.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Umntu obunzima obuzipawundi eziyi-200 (iikhologram eziyi-90) emhlabeni anganobunzima obumalunga neepawundi eziyi-36 (iikhilogram eziyi-16) kwi lo. Ngoko ke igravithi, kakade,itsala kancinci kuwe.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Ilanga alinaqweqwe njengoMhlaba onoma kuwo. Ilanga lonke lenziwe ngeegesi, umlilo, kunye neplasma.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Igesi iya incipha njengoko usiya ubhekela kumbindi welanga.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Inxalenye engaphandle esiyibonayo xa sijonga iLnaga kuthiwa yi-photosphere, nto leyo ethetha “ibhola yokukhanya.”
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Malunga neminyaka engamawaka amathathu kamva, ngo-1610, iGalileo Galilei inzululwazi yeenkwenkwenzi engum-Itali yasebenzisa iteleskophu ukuze ibone ukuba i-Venus nayo inamaxesha, kanye njengokuba nenyanga isifa.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Amaxesha enyanga enzeka ngenxa yokuba licala leVenus kuphela (okanye lenyanga) elidla ngokukhanyiswa lilanga. Amaxesha eVenus axhasa uhlalutyo lukaCopernicus oluthi iiplanethi zijikeleza Ilanga.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Emva koko, kwiminyaka embalwa kamva, ngo-1639, isazinzulu ngeenkwenkwezi saseNgilani ekuthiwa nguJeremiah Horrocks sabona ukudlula kwe-Venus elangeni.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: INgilane yafumana ixesha elide loxolo emva kokuphinda yoyise i-Danelaw.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Nangona ngo 991 uEthelred wayejongene ne Viking fleet eyayinkulu ukugqitha naayiphina ukususela nge-century yangamphabili ko Guthrum's .
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Le nqanawa yayikhokelwa ngu-Olaf Trygvasson, waseNorway onamabhongo okubuyisa ilizwe lakhe kulawulo lwaseDenmark.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Emva kweengxaki zomkhosi, u-Ethelred wakwazi ukufikelela kwisivumelwano kunye no-Olaf owabuyela eNorway ukuze azame ukuphinde athathe ubukhosi bakhe kodwa impumelelo yayingacaci ncam.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: I-Hangeul yiyo yodwa intlobo yoonobumbao eyenziwa ngabom esetyenziswa imihla ngemihla. Oonobumba bayilwa ngo-1444 ngexa kuphethe uKumkani u-Sejong (1418 – 1450).
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Ukumkani Sejong wayengukumkani wesine woBukumkani bamJoseon yaye ngomnye wabanconywa kakhulu.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Ekuqaleni wabiza i-Hangeul alfabhethi i-Hunmin Jeongeum, oko kukuthi "izandi ezichanekileyo zokufundisa abantu".
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Zininzi iitheory zokuba ISanskrit yabakho njani. Enye yazo inge Aryan migration besuka e west ye India abaza nemithwalo .
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: IsiSanskrit lulwimi lwakudala kwaye luyathelekiseka nolwimi lwesiLatin oluthethwa eYurophu.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Eyona ncwadi yakudala eyaziwayo elizweni yayibhalwe nge-Sanskrit. Emva koqokelelo kwe-Upinshads, i-Sanskrit yaphelelwa yanyamalala ngenxa yokweqiwa.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: I-Sanskrit lulwimi oluxananazileyo nolutyebileyo, elubangele ukuba libe sisiseko selwimi ezinintsi ze Indiya yanamhlanje, njengesiLatini isisiseko sezilwimi zaseYurophu njengesiFrentshi neSipanish.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Yakuphela imfazwe nxamnye neFransi, iJamani yaqalisa ukuhlasela isiqithi saseBritane.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: I code yase-Jamani ebizwa ngokuba yi “Operation Sealion”.Izixhobo ezinintsi zomkhosi omkhulu wase Britane nozixhaso zawo zaye zalahleka xa babesimka e-Dunkirk, ngoko ke umkhosi wawunkenenkene.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Kodwa iRoyal Navy yayinamandla ngaphezu kweGerman Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) yaye yayinokuwoyisa umkhosi ohlaselayo ongena nge-English Channel.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Ngoko ke , zazimbalwa kakhulu inqanawa Zomkhosi Wamanzi ezazikufuphi nendawo zohlaseleko njengoko intloko zasisoyika ukuzikiswa luhlaselo ngumkhosi womya weJamani.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Masiqale ngekcaza malunga neeplani zase Italy. I Italy yaye ingu "mninawa" we Jamani ne Japan.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Yayinomkhosi ongomelelanga kunye nomkhosi waselwandle ongenamandla, nangona babesanda ukwenza iinqanawa ezine ezintsha kanye ngaphambi kokuqalisa kwemfazwe.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Iinjongo eziphambili zase-Itali yayingamazwe aseAfrika. Ukuthimba loo mazwe, kwakuza kufuneka babe nephedi yokuqalisa umkhosi, ukuze umkhosi uwele uLwandle lweMeditera uhlasele iAfrika.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Ngenxa yoko, kwafuneka balahle iziseko zase-Bhritane kunye neenqanawa e-Egypt. Ngaphandle kwala manyathelo, iinqwelo zokulwa zase-Italiya zazingafanelekanga ukuba zenze enye into.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Ngoku nge Japan. IJapan yayililizwe lesiqithi, njengeBritane.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Iinqwela mafutha ezintywilayo zenzelwe ukuhambha phantsi kwamanzi, futhi zihlale njalo amaxesha amade ngethuba.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Iinqwelo mafutha ezintywilayo zazisetyenziswa kwi-Mfazwe yeZwelonke I futhi nakwi-Mfazwe yeZwelonke II. Ngeloxesha zazicotha zidubulela kufuphi.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Ekuqaleni kwemfazwe ubukhulu becala babehamba ngaphezulu elwandle, kodwa njengoko irada yaqalisa ukukhula kunye nokuchaneka ngakumbi, iinkwili zanyanzeleka ukuba zihambe ngaphantsi kwamanzi ukuphepha ukubonwa.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Iinkwili zaseJamani zazibizwa ngokuba zii-U-Boats. AmaJamani ayengamachule ekuqhubeni nasekusebenziseni iinkwili zazo.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Ngenxa yempumelelo yabo ngenkwili, emva kwemfazwe abase Germans abathembakalanga ukuba basenonintsi lwazo.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Ewe! UKumkani uTutankhamun, ngamanye amaxesha abizwa ngokuba ngu "King Tut" okanye "The boy King", ngomnye wokumkani bamandulo base-Egypt abasaziwayo kweli xesha lethu.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Into ebangela umdla, wayengagqalwa njengobalulekileyo kumaxesha amanduula yaye wayedla ngokungafakwa kuluhlu oluninzi olwalubhala ingxelo yookumkani.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Nangona kunjalo, ukufunyanwa kwengcwaba lakhe ngo-1922 kwamenza waduma. Ngelixa amangcwaba amaninzi exesha eladlilayo erojiwe, eli ngcwaba lashiyeka liphazamisekile.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Izinto ezininzi ezingcwatywe kunye noTutankhamun ziye zagcinwa kakuhle, kuquka izinto ezingamawaka ezenziwe ngamatye anqabileyo kunye nezimbiwa.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Ukwenziwa kwevili elinezipowukhi kwenza iinqwelo zokulwa zama-Asiriya zingabi nzima, zikhawuleze zize zikwazi ukubaleka ngaphambi kwamajoni kunye nezinye iinqwelo.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Iintola e ezivela kwindlela enqamlezileyo inokungena kwisikrweqe sokulwa samajoni. Malunga ne-1000 B.C.E., ama-Asiriya azisa ihashe lokuqala.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: IKhalvari ngumkhosi olwa ukhwele ehashini,Isali yayingekabikho, ngoko ke ikhalvari yama Assria yalwa ngemiqolo eze yamahashe abo.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Sazi ama-Greek amaninzi epolitiki, abenzululwazi abadali begcisa. Inoba oyena mmtu owaziwayo welixesha ngu-Homer, inkunzi yembongo eyayiyimfama, owabhala iimcwadi ezimbhini ezobona buchule zemibhalo yama-Greek: u-Iliad no-Odyssey.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: U-Sophocles no-Aristophanes basengabhali bemiboniso abaziwayo futhi nemiboniso yabo isanconywa njengemiboniso engeyiwayo elizweni lemibhalo.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Omnye umGrike odumileyo ngu-Pythagoras umfundisi wezibalo, odume ngethiyorem yakhe malunga nokumelana namacala kanxa-ntathu.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Kukho uqikelelo olubethabethanayo malunga nokuba bangaphi abantu abathetha isi-Hindi. Kuqikelelwa ukuba siphakathi kwelwimi lwesibini okanye lwesine kwiilwimi ezithethwa kakhulu..
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Inani lezithethi zemveli liyehluka ngokuxhomekeka ekubeni zibaliwe na okanye hayi ezona zisondele kakhulu kololwimi.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Kuqikelelwa ukuba luthethwa ngabantu abayi-340 miliyoni ukuya kwabayi-500 miliyoni, nokuba olu lwimi luviwa ngabantu abayi-800 miliyoni.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Isii-Hindi nesi-Urdu ziyelelene ngamagama kodwa zohlukile ngokubhalwa; kwincoko yemihla ngemihla, abathethi bezi lwimi zombini bayakwazi ukuvana.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Malunga nenkulungwane ye-15, i-Estonia ibiphantsi kwempembelelo yeJamani kwezenkcubeko.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Ezinye iiMonki zaseJamani zazifuna ukusondeza uThixo kubantu bomthonyama, ngoko zayila ulwimi lwase-Estonia lomthonyama.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Yayisingiselwe kwi Alfabhethi yase Jamani ne kharaktha enye engu "Õ/õ" yongezwa.
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Njengoko ixesha lihamba, amagama amanintsi awayebolekwe kwisi German adibana. Oku yaba kukuqala kokukhanyiselwa.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Ngokwesiko, indlalifa kakumkani yayisiya emajonini ukugqiba kwayo isikolo.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Kodwa ke, uCharles wafunda eyunivesithi eTrinity College, eCambridge apho wafunda khona izifundo ngoluntu nemvelaphi yoluntu, ibe kamva ezeMbali, efumana 2:2 (isidanga seklasi yesibini esezantsi).
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: UCharles wayelilungu lokuqala Usapho Lwasebukhosini lweBritane ukunikwa isidanga.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: I-European Turkey (eastern Thrace okanye i-Rumelia ekwi Balkan peninsula) iqukai 3% yelizwe.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Ummandla waseTurkey ungaphezu kweekhilomitha eziyi-1600 (1,000 mi) ubude kunye neekhilomitha eziyi-800 (500 mi) ububanzi, kwaye ibonakala ngathi lixande ngokobume bawo.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Ummandla waseTurkey kuquka amachibi ufikelela kwi-783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), apho i-755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) zikumzantsi ntshona we-Asia yaye i-23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) iseYurophu.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Indawo yaseTurkey iyenza ilizwe le-37 ngobukhulu kumazwe onke, kwaye ilingana nobukhulu beMetropolitan France kunye ne-United Kingdom zidityanisiwe.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: I Turkey irhangqwe ziilwandle kumacala amathathu: ulwandle i-Aegean entshona, ulwandle Olumnyama kumantla kunye nolwandle lweMediterranean kumazantsi.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: ILuxembourg inembali ende kodwa inkululeko yayo isukela ngo-1839.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Iindawo ezithile zanamhlanje zaseBelgium zisukela kuba yiLuxembourg kudala kodwa zayi yiBelgian emva kwengququko yase Belgian ngo 1830s .
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: I Luxembourg yayisoloko izama ukuhlala ililizwe elingathathi cala kodwa yaye yahlaselwa kwimfazwe yokuqala Yehalabathi neMfazwe Yesibini Yehlabathi yi ngaMajamani.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Ngo-1957 iLuxembourg yaba lilungu elingumseki walo mbutho ngoku namhlanje owaziwa ngokuba yiEuropean Union.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: IDrukgyal Dzong yinqaba engamabhodlo kwaye ikwayindlu yoonongendi bamaBhuda kwinxalenye ephezulu ye-Paro District (ePhondey Village).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Kuthiwa ngo-1649, uZhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel wenza inqaba yokukhumbula uloyiso awayenalo esilwa nemikhosi yaseTibetan-Mongol.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Ngo-1951, wabangela ukuba kushiyeke ezinye iziqwenga zeDrukgyal Dzong zona ezifana nomfanekiso kaZhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Emvakomlilo, inqaba ibigciniwe futhi ikhuselwe, ishiyeka njengenye yezona ndawo zintle zase-Bhutan.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Ngexesha le-18th sentyhuri iCambodia yazifumana icinezelekile phakathi kwabamelwane ababini abanamandla, iThailand neVietnam.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: AmaThai ayihlasela kaninzi iCambodia ngenkulungwane ye18 kway ngo-1772 aye atshabalilisa iPhnom Phen.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Kwiminyaka yokugqibela ye-18 sentyhuri iVietnam yahlasela neKhambodiya.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Ishumi elinesibhozo leepesenti kubantu baseVenuezela abaphangeli, yaye uninzi lwabo lusebenza kwicandelo lezoqoqosho labantu abaziqeshileyo nelingekho phantsi kolawulo lwemithetho karhulumente.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Ababini kwabathathu baseVenezuela abasebenza kwicandelo leenkonzo benjenje, basebenza phantse ikota yomsebenzi kumzi mveliso kunye nesihlanu somsebenzi kwezolimo.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: I umzi-mveliso obalulekileyo e-Venezuela yi Oyile, apho ilizwe limengokuyithengisa, nangonga iyipsesenti enye yabo basebenza kule indastri ye oyile.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Ekuqaleni kwenkululeko yesizwe, ubuchwephesha baseSingapore Botanic Gardens banceda ukuguqula esi siqithi saba ngumyezo oyi Garden City.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Ngo-1981, iVanda Miss Joaquim, intyantyambo entle engumxube nezinye, iye yakhethwa njengentyantyambo yesizwe.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Eloko nyaka malunga nenyaga ka Oktobha phantse izilwanyanana ezitya uhlaza ezi yi 1.5 yezigidi zihambela kumathafa akumazantsi, zinqumla umlambo I Mara, ukusuka kwiinduli ezikumantla ukuya kwimvula.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Futhi ubuyele emantla unqumule bucala ngasekunene, emva konqumula umfula we-Maria, emva kweemvula zenyanga uTshazimpuzi.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Ummandla weSerengeti uquka i-Serengeti National Park, iNgorongoro Conservation Area neMaswa Game Reserve eTanzania naseMaasai Mara National Reserve eKenya.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Ukufunda ngemidiya ephilayo kudinga ukuba ubenezakhono zalamaxesha kanti nezo zakudala, kunye nezixhobo oziphumelele kwizifundo zokulinganisa (ukuchaza ngamabali, izandi noku editha, ividiyo ukubalisa amabali njalo njalo.)
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Ukudizayina kufuna usoloko uhlola izinto obuzicingele malunga nokuvelisa izinto zemidiya kunye nokucinga ngendlela ezahlukileyo.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Uyilo olusebenzisanayo lufuna ukuba izinto zeprojekthi zinxibelelane, kodwa zenze okusezingqondweni njengezinto ezahlukileyo.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Into engekhontle ngeeglasi zezoom kukuba ubunzima obujolayo kunye nenani lezinto zelensi ezifunekayo ukwenza kubekho uluhlu lokujonga okulugqithileyo likhulu kakhulu kuneelensi eziphambili.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Le iya iyeka ukuba yingxaki njengoko abavelisi beelensi bevelisa iilensi ezikumgangatho ophezulu.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Oku kubangele ukuba ilensi ezumayo ikhuphe imifanekiso ecacileyo xa uyithelekanisa ne focal lensi ezinzileyo.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Enye into engathandekiyo ngeelensi zokusondeza kukuba santya selensi sidla ngokuba phantsi.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Oku kwenza iilensi zokusondeza ezingekho duru kube nzima ukuzisebenzisa kwiimeko ezinesibane esiphantsi ngaphandle fleshi.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Enye yeengxaki eziqhelekileyo xa kuzanywa ukutshintsha imuvi ekwifomathi ye-DVD yingxaki yokusika imifanekiso.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Uninzi loomabona kude lwenziwe ngendlela yokukholisa uluntu ngokubanzi.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Ngeso sizathu, yonke into oyibonayo kumabonakude isikwe imida, ngaphezulu, ezantsi kunye namacala.
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Oku kwenziwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba umfanekiso ugcwalisa isikrini sonke. Oku kubizwa ngokuba yi-overscan.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Ngelishwa, xawusenza i-DVD, imida yayo, futhi ukuba ibinemibhalo yotoliko ezisondele kakhulu ezantsi, zisenongaveli.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Inqaba yesiqhelo idla ngokubangela umfanekiso ngqondweni wemilo, amatheko kunye nobuntu bexesha lika-Arthur.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Sowume phakathi kwezakhiwo ezineminyaka eliwaka-ubudala kulula ukuzisa ingcamango zezandi namaphunga eemfazo zakudala, uphantse uwuve umgqabadulo weenqweba zehashe ematyeni futhi uve iphunga loloyiko lisonyuka emhadini.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Kodwa ngaba izinto esizicingelayo zisekelwe kwizinto zokwenene? Kwakutheni ukuze kwakhiwe iinqaba endaweni yokuqala? Zaziyilwe zaza zakhiwa njani?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Ngokuqhelekileyo ngeli xesha, iKirby Muxloe castle yeyona ndlu inqatyisiweyo kunenqaba yokwenyani.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Iifestile zayo ezirhuwkileyo namadonga ayo anciphileyo ebengenokwazi ukumela uhlaselo oluqinilileyo kangangexesha elide.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Ngoo-1480, apho ulakhiwo kwayo laqalwa ngoo-Hastings, ilizwe belinoxolo kwaye nokhuselo belufane ludingeke nxamnye namaqelana abagulukuthu abazulayo.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Ulinganiso lwamandla yayiyinkqubo ebifunwa zizizwe zase-Europe ukuze zigcine ubungangamsha bamazwe onke ase-Europe.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Ingcamango yayikukuba onke amazwe seYurophu kwakufuneka ajonge indlela yokuthintela ilizwe elinye ukuba lebe namandla, ngoko oorhulumente babedla ngokutshintsha amahlakane awo ukuze oku kwenzeke.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Imfazwe ye Spanish Succession yaphawula imfazwe yokuqala eyayinjongo zayo ikukulungelelanisa amagunya.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Oku kwaphawula utshintsho olubalulekileyo, njengoko amagunya aseYurophu ayengasayi kuba nasizathu sokuba neemfazwe zonqulo. Ke, iMfazwe yeminyaka engamashumi amathathu yayiya kuba yimfazwe yokugqibela eya kubizwa ngokuba yimfazwe yeenkolo.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Itempile ka-Artemis yase-Efese yatshatyalaliswa ngee-21 zikaJulayi ngo-356 BCE xa yatshatyalaliswa ngomlilo nguHerostratus.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Ngokwebali, injongo yakhe yayikuduma nobakanjani. Ama-Efijian, ecaphukile, athi igama lika Herostratus lingaze libhalwe.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Umbhali-mbali ongumGrike uStrabo waqaphela eli gama , le yindlela esazi ngayo namhlanje. Itempile yatshatyalaliswa ngobo busuku bunye bokuzalwa kuka-Alexander the Great.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: UAlexander, njengekumkani, wazinikela ukuyakha itempile, kodwa umnikelo wakhe wakhatywa. Ethubeni, akuba u Alexander ebhubhile, itempile yakhiwa ngokutsha ngo-323 BCE.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Qiniseka ukuba isandla sakho sikhululekile kangangoko ngelixa ubetha zonke ezinye inotes ngokuchanileyo-kwakhona zama ukuba ungashukushukumisi kakhulu iminwe yakho.
eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Ngale ndlela, uya kuzidinisa kancinci kangangoko. Khumbula ukuba akukho mfuneko yokubetha amaqhosha ngamandla amakhulu kuba ufuna ivolumu eyongezelelweyo njengepiyano.
eng_text: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Xa udlala ikhodiyane, ukuze ikhwaze ngakumbi, cinezela amaphondo kakhulu uze ukhawulezise xa uyicofa.
eng_text: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: IMysticism kuleqe ubudlelane no, ukuzazisa ku, okanye ukuqonda ngengqiqo obona bunyani, ubumoya, inyaniso yokomoya, okanye uThixo.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Okholelwayo udinga ukuzibonela, ukuzicingela, okanye ukubona iinyani zendalo ezimsulwa/isithixo okanye izthixo.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Abalandeli baphila ngendlela ethile, okanye benza izinto ezenzelwe ukugcina loo mava.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Ukufuna ulwazi ngeendlela ezintsokothileyo kwahlulwa kwezinye iintlobo zoluqulo ngokugxininisa amava obuqu okuzazi ingakumbi ukuba seluxolweni, ukuqonda, ulonwabo okanye umntu ovuyayo.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: I-Sikhism yinkolo evela kwi-Indian sub-continent. Iphuma kwingingqi yasePunjab ngexehsa le-15 sentyhuri ukusuka kuqhekeko lwabo kwisithethe samaHindu.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: AmaSikh alubona unqulo lwawo lwahlukile kubuHindu, nangona eyivuma ukuba luvela kubuHindu yaye lunezithethe zabo.
eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Ama-Sikh abiza inkolo yabo I-Gurmat, esisi-Punjabi esithetha ukuthi "indlela yomfundisi". Umfundisi yinto ebabuleke kangangoko kwiinkolo zama-Ndiya kodwa kwi-Sikhism ubalelona lungu libalulekileyo kwezona nkolo zee-Sikhs.
eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Le nkolo yaqalwa ngenkulungwane ye-15 nguMfundisi u-Nanak (1469-1539). Apho kwalandela ngokusekela abanye abafundisi abalithoba.
eng_text: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Kodwa ke, ngeyeSilimela ngo-1956, izithembiso zika-Kruchev zavavanywa ngo qhanqalazo lwase-Poland, apho anasebenzi babelwela ukunqaba lokutya nokuphungulwa kwemivuzo, yaijika yayitoyitoyi eyaphetha iphikisa i-Communism.
eng_text: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Nangona ekugqibeleni, uKrushchev wathumela amatanki ukubuyisela ucwangco, wayenza indlela kwiimfuno ezithile zoqoqosho kwaye wavuma ukumisela uWladyslaw Gomulka owaziwayo njengenkulumbuso entsha.
eng_text: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Impucuko ye-Indus Valley yayiyimpucuko yeBronze Age kumazantsi mpuma eIndiya equka uninzi lwePakistan yanamhlanje kunye neminye imimandla emantla ntshona eIndiya nakwimpuma yeAfghanistan.
eng_text: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Impucuko yachuma koovimba beIndus River kulapho ke iqambe igama layo.
eng_text: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Nangona ingcali ziqikelela ukuba ngenxa yokuba ukhanyo lwalukhona nakwintlango yomlambo i Sarasvati, imele ukubizwa njenge Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, ngelixa abanye beyibiza njengeHarappan Civilization esukela kwiHarappa, indawo yokuqala ukombiwa ngomnyaka ka-1920.
eng_text: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Ukuba ngabantu bemvazwe kwaRoma kwancedisa kuphuhliso lwenkqubela phambili kwezonyango.
eng_text: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Oogqirha baqala ukukhangelwa yiRhuluneli Augustus wade waqulunqa ikhophoration yokuqala yeRoman Medical Corps ukuze isetyenziswe emva kwesithonga seemfazwe.
eng_text: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Ogqirha abaqhaqhayo babenolwazi lwezinto ezahlukeneyo zokunyanga kubandakanya i-morphine ecatshulwe embewini ye-poppy kunye ne-scopolamine evela kwimbewu ye-herbane.
eng_text: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Baba ziincutshe ekunqumleni amalungu omzimba ukuze basindise izigulana ekubeni zibole kwakunye nezixhobo zokubamba amalungu omzimba ukuze kuncitshiwe ukopha.
eng_text: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Kumakhulukhulu eminyaka emininzi,ubungangamsha bama Roma bakhokhela kwingeniso ezinkulu kwicandelo lamachiza baqulunqa ulwazi olunintsi esinalo namhlanje.
eng_text: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: I Pureland origami yi origami enemiqathango ethi ifoldi enye mayenziwe kanye ngexesha, ifoldi ezinintsi njengeziphendulelekileyo azivumelekanga, kwaye zonke ifolds zinendawo zazo ezicacileyo.
eng_text: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Yeenziwa nguJohn Smith kwiminyaka yee-1970 ukunceda iifolda ezingenamava okanye ezo zinobuchule bemoto obulinganiselweyo.
eng_text: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Abantwana bangakwazi ukuqonda ubuhlanga nendlela uhlanga olujongwa ngayo besebancinci yaye ezi mbono ngohlanga zingachaphazela indlela abaziphatha ngayo.
eng_text: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Umzekelo, abantwana bebala elithile elijongelwa phantsi kwezemfundo baqhele ukungenzi kakuhle esikolweni emva koba bevile.
eng_text: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: U-MySpace ngumnathazwe wesithathu oyena udumileyo enizigidi zeeprofayile eziyi-54.
eng_text: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Le webhusaythi ifumane umqaphela omkhulu ikakhulu kwisetingi yezemfundo.
eng_text: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Kukho izinto ezincomekayo kwezi webhusayithi, zona ziquka ukukwazi ukwenza iphepha leklasi elinokuquka iiblogi, iividiyo, iifoto kunye nezinye iinkalo.
eng_text: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Eli phepha lingafumaneka lula ngokuthi unikezele nje ngedilesi enye yewebhusaythi, eyenza kubelula ukukhumbula nokutayipha kubafundi abanokuba nengxaki ukusebenziseni ikeybhodi okanye ukupela.
eng_text: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Ingatshintshwa yenziwe ilungele wena ukuze kube lula ukuyifunda ibe kufakwe umbala omncinci kangangoko kunokwenzeka ngendlela ofuna ngayo.
eng_text: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: I-Attention Deficit Disorder “sisigulo sengqondo esineempawu ezintathu eziqhelekileyo eziquka ukuvele wenze izinto, ukuphazamiseka msinyane kuquka nokudlamka okugqithiseleyo.”
eng_text: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Ayikokungakwazi ukufunda, ngumkhwa wokuphazamiseka ekufundeni;iye “ichaphazele aba 3 ukuya kwaba 5 abantwana bonke, mhlawumbi ukuya kutsho kubantwana abakwizigidi ezibini zase Melika”.
eng_text: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Abantwana abane-ADD bayanzinyelwa kukunikela ingqalelo kwizinto ezifana nomsebenzi wesikolo, kodwa bayakwazi ukunikela ingqalelo kwizinto abakuthandayo ukuzenza njengokudlala imidlalo okanye ukubukela oopopayi ababathandayo okanye ukubhala izivakalisi ezingenaziphumlisi.
eng_text: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Abababantwana badla ngokungena engxakini, kuba “benza izinto eziyingozi, bangena imilwo, futhi baphikisana nomthetho” ukuze bazivuse iingqondo, kuba iingqondo zabu azikwazi ukuvuswa ngendlela eziqhelekileyo.
eng_text: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: I-ADD ichaphazela ulwalamano kunye noontanga babo, ngenxa yokuba abanye abantwana abakwazi ukuqonda ukuba kutheni besenza izinto ngale ndlela benza ngayo okanye kutheni bepela amagama ngendlela abapela ngayo okanye ukukhula kwabo kutheni kwahlukile.
eng_text: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Njengokuba indlela yokufumana ulwazi nokufunda intshintshe ngolona hlobo oluphezulu oludlula indlela ulwazi elalifumaneka ngayo lutshintshile.
eng_text: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Indlela yokufumana inkcazelo yayahlukile. Kwakungaseyo mfuneko yokuba umntu akhumbule, kodwa kwanikelwa ingqalelo ekukwazini ukukhumbula amagama.
eng_text: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Ngokuyintloko, Imvuselelo yenza utshintsho olukhulu kwindlela yokujonga ukufunda kunye nendlela yokudlulisela ulwazi.
eng_text: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Ngoku ngafani nezinye ii-primates, ii-hominids azisasebenzisi izandla ukuhamba okanye ukuthwala umthwalo okanye ukujinga emithini.
eng_text: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Isandla kunye nonyawo lwetshimpanzi ziyafana ngokobude nobukhulu, into ebonisa ukuba iyasisebenzisa isandla ukuze ibambelele ngaso xa ihamba.
eng_text: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Isandla somntu sikufutshane kunonyawo, sinamathambo ezilukhuni.
eng_text: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: IiFosili zamathambho ezandla aneminyaka engaku-2 yezigidi no-3 yezigidi zeminyaka iveza utshintsho ekufanelekeni kwesandla ukusuka ekuhambheni ukuya ekubambheni.
eng_text: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuba ukuphupha kakhuluamaphupha enziwe ngabantu kuyadinisa.
eng_text: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Esona sizathu siphambili sale nto sisiphumo samaphupha amnandi okwandisa ubude bexesha phakathi kwe-REM.
eng_text: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

eng_text: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

eng_text: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

eng_text: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: I-Nervouse System yengqondo ikhathalela i-homestasis ngokuthumela izithongana kumzimba wonke ukugcina ukubaleka kwegazi kungaphazamisekanga.

eng_text: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

eng_text: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Abantu abathathe inxaxheba kumashumi eminyaka basinceda ukuba sizixabise izinto esizenza kakuhle kunye neminqweno yethu ngoxa sivavanya izinto ezinzima kunye nalapho singaqhubi kakuhle khona.
eng_text: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Ngoxa besimamele amabali abantu obuqu, eentsapho kunye nawentlangano, siye safumana ukuqonda ngembali kunye nendlela abanye abantu abaye baphembelela ngayo indlela esebenza ngayo intlangano enoba kakuhle okanye kakube.
eng_text: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Xa uyiqonda imbali yomntu oko akuthethi ukuba uyayiqonda inkcubeko yakhe, kodwa iyabanceda abantu bafumane ukuqonda apho kukhona ukushota kwimbali yombutho.
eng_text: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Ngoxa ehlola ukuphumelela aze abone nalapho kusilelwe khona, umntu ngamnye nabantu bonke abanenxaxheba xa bedibene baye beyiqonda kangumbi imigaqo, izinto ezifuna ukwenziwa nezinto eziqhuba inkampani.
eng_text: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Kweli xesha, ukukhumbula kumaxa angaphambili emikhwa yoshishino enemiphumela kwimpumelelo yanceda abantu ukuba bavumele utshintsho banike nomkhomba Ndlela kwibandla elisekuhlaleni.
eng_text: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Loo mabali ayimpumelelo ayakunciphisa ukoyika utshintsho, ngelixa edala ingcingane ezakhaya kwimo yotshintsho.
eng_text: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Indlela yokucinga emanyanisa amacebo yindlelo yokucombulula ingxaki edibanisa amacebo ahlukahlukeneyo okanye amacebo avela kumacandelo ahlukahlukeneyo ukuze kufunyanwe isicombululo.
eng_text: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Injongo zalomboni sijoliswe kwisantya, kulandelelwano nakwinkcaneko nasekuphawuleni amanqanaba, kuphindaphindwe amacebo akhoyo, kuqokelelwe ulwazi.
eng_text: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Eyona nto ibaluleke kakhulu kule ngqondo yile: inye kuphela impendulo echanekileyo. Ucinga kuphela ngeempendulo ezimbini, nazi ezilungile okanye azilunganga.
eng_text: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Le ndlela yokucinga inxulunyaniswa nesayensi ethile okanye imigaqo nkqubo ethile esisiseko.
eng_text: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Abantu abacinga ngale ndlela bacinga kakuhle, bayakwazi ukunqaya izinto ezihambiselanayo, ukucombulula iingxaki nokusebenza kuphando lwezesayensi.
eng_text: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Abantu yeyona ndalo inesiphiwo sokufunda iingqondo yabanye.
eng_text: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Oko kuthetha ukuba siyakwazi ukuqikelela ngempumelelo ukuba oko abanye abantu abakuqondayo, abafuna ukukwenza, abakhukholelwayo, abakwazi nabakunqwenelayo.
eng_text: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Phakathi kwezi zinto ukuqonda iinjongo zabanye kubalulekile. Kusivumela siqonde ukuphikisana kwezenzo.
eng_text: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Ngokomzekelo, ukuba ubona umntu esophula ifestile yemoto, ubunokucinga ukuba uzama ukuyiba loo moto.
eng_text: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Kwakuyakufuneka agwetywe ngokwahlukileyo ukuba ebelahle izitshixo zemoto yakhe yaye iyimoto yakhe lena wayezama ukuyiqhekeza.
eng_text: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: MRI ibhekiselele kummangaliso ee -hysics obizwa ngokuba yi-magnetic resonance( NMR), eyafunyaniswa ngo-1930 nguFelix Bloch( esebenza e Stanford University) no-Edward Purcell( waseHarvad University).
eng_text: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Ekuhambeni kwamaza esandi, amaza ereyidiyo nawe-magnetic field, abangela ukuba ii-athomu zikhuphe iisignali zereyidiyo ezimbalwa.
eng_text: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Ngonyaka ka-1970, uRaymond Damadian, ongugqirha nomphengululi wososayensi, wafumana isizathu sokusebezisa isithwebuli mifanekiso esingumazibuthe njengesixhobo sokuxilonga isigulo.
eng_text: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Kwiminyaka emine ethubeni ubunini banikezwa, eyayibubunini bokuqala ukunikezwa kwical le MRI.
eng_text: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Ngo-1977, uGq. Damadian wagqibebezela ukwakhiwa kwe “whole-body” MRI scanner, awayibiza ngokuba yi“indomitable”.
eng_text: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Unxibelelwano oluqhubekekayo lukhuthaza ixesha lokucinga kunye nokuphendula kwabanye.
eng_text: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Ivumela abafundi ukuba bakwazi ukusebenza ngesantya abasifunayo baze balawule isantya semfundiso.
eng_text: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Ukongezelela, kukho imiqathango yexesha kusenokwenzeka ukuba lona ixesha lokusebenza libe bhetyebhetye. (Bremer, 1998)
eng_text: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Ukusetyenziswa kwe-Intanethi kwenza abafundi bakwazi ukufikelela kwinkcazelo ngamaxesha onke.
eng_text: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Abafundi banagakwazi ukunikezela imibuzo kubafundisi nangeliphi na ixesha futhi balindele iimpendulo ezikhawulezileyo, kunoba balinde ukudibana ubuso ngobuso.
eng_text: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Indlela yokufunda esemva inika inkululeko kwimilinganiselo. Akukho ndlela inye ilungileyo yokufunda.
eng_text: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Enyanisweni, akukho nanye into entle onokuyifunda. Ukufunda kubakho phakathi komfundi kunye nento efundiswayo.
eng_text: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Amava esinawo ngezi zinto zithi zenzele ngokwakho, nenkcazelo edluliselwayo, ukufunda ngokubukela umabonakude kubonisa kanye le ngongoma.
eng_text: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Baninzi kuthi abazibona bebukele inkqubo kamabonakude esibonisa ngeenkqubo okanye izinto esingasoze sizenze okanye ulwazi esingasoze silusebenzise.
eng_text: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Asoze siyiqale phantsi injini yemoto, sakhe umthombo emva kwendlu yethu, sityelele ePeru ukuze siyokubona amabhodlo akudla, okanye silungise indlu yommelwane.
eng_text: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Ngenxa yeentambo ze-fiber optic ezingaphantsi kolwandle namakhonkco aya kwi Europe kunye ne-broadband satellite, iGreenland iqhagamshelekee kakuhle yaye inabantu abayi-93% abanokufikelela kwi intanethi.
eng_text: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Ihotele yakho okanye umamkeli (ukuba uhlala kwindlu yendwendwe okanye kwikhaya labucala) lisenokuba ne compyutha ene wifi okanye I intaneti kwaye zonke indawo zokuhlala zinevenkile ye intaneti okanye ingingqi ene wifi kawonke wonke.
eng_text: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Njengokuba sekukhankanyiwe ngasentla, nangona igama elithi "Eskimo" lihlala lamkelekile eUnited States, lithathwa njengolonyeliso ngabantu abaninzi abangahlali base-Arctic, ngakumbi eCanada.
eng_text: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Nangona usenokuva abantu abazinzalelwane zaseGreenland belisebenzisa eli gama, abantu abangengabo abaphaya bamele bangalisebenzisi.
eng_text: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Abemi abazinzalelwane zaseGreenland bazibiza ngokuba ngama-Inuit eCanada naseKalaalleq (isininzi iKalaallit), iGreenlander, eGreenland.
eng_text: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Ulwaphulo-mthetho, nokuphatha kakubi iimbacu ngokuqhelekileyo, ayaziwa konke konke e Greenland. Nasezidolophini, akukho ndawo "zirhabaxa".
eng_text: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Imozulu ebandayo yiyo eyibubungozi bokwenene abanokudibana nayo abo bangalungiselelanga.
eng_text: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Xa utyelela iGreenland ngamaxesha onyaka abandayo (ucinge into yokuba xa usiya, usiya ngasentla, kungona kubanda), kubaluleke kakhulu ukuba uphathe impahla eshushu ngokwaneleyo.
eng_text: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Iintsuku ezinde kakhulu ehlotyeni zinokukhokelela kwiingxaki zokulala ngokwaneleyo kunye neengxaki ezinxulumene nempilo.
eng_text: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Ngexesha lasehlotyeni, jonga kwakhona iingcongconi zaseNordic. Nangona zingasasazi zifo, zianokucaphukisa.
eng_text: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Ngoxa ezoqoqosho zaseSan Franciso zinxibelelene nayo ekubeni yindawo ethandwayo ephambili kubakhenkethi, zahlukahlukene ezoqoqosho lwayo.
eng_text: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Awona macandelo makhulu engqesho ziinkonzo zeengcali, urhulumente, ezezimali, urhwebo kunye nokhenketho.
eng_text: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Ukubonisa kwayo umculo, iifilimu, imfundo kunye nenkcubeko edumileyo rhoqo kuncede ukwenza isixeko kunye neempawu zaso zaziwe kwihlabathi liphela.
eng_text: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: I-San Francisco yenze kwabakho izinto ezininzi ezisetyenziswa ngabahambi ngieehotelezayo ezininzi, iindawo zokutya, kunye neendawo zenkomfa ezingayiwayo.
eng_text: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: I-San Francisco yenye yeendawo ezibalaseleyo kwesisizwe ukufumana ukutya kwase- Asia: Korean, Thai, Indian, kunye ne-Japanese.
eng_text: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Ukuya kwiWalt Disney World kubonisa uhambo oluphambili kwiintsapho ezininzi zaseMelika.
eng_text: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Utyelelo "oluqhelekileyo" lubandakanya ukuhamba ngenqwelomoya kwisikhululo seenqwelomoya iOrlando International Airport, ukukhwela ibhasi usiya kwihotele eseDisney, ukuchitha iveki ungakhange ushiye umhlaba waseDisney, uphinde ubuyele ekhaya.
eng_text: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Azibaleki izinto ezingumahloko ezinokubakho, kodwa le ihlala iyile nto ithethwa ngabantu xa bethetha “ngokuya e-Disney World.”
eng_text: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Amatikiti amaninzi athengwe kwi-intanethi kwiwebhusayithi zokuthengisa ezifana noeBay okanye uCraigslist asetyenziswa ngokuyinxalenye njengamatiki okupaka iintsuku eziliqela.
eng_text: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Ngelixa lo ingumsebenzi oqhelekileyo, uyathintelwa yiDisney: amatikiti wona awadluliseki.
eng_text: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Nayiphi na inkampu engezantsi komda eGrand Canyon ifuna imvume yokuhlala.
eng_text: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Iipemithi zimbalwa ukuze kukhuselwe umwonyo, yaye zifumaneka ngomhla woku-1 enyangeni, kwiinyanga ezine ngaphambi kokuqala kwenyanga.
eng_text: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Ngoko, imvume yamva yokuqala nangawuphi na umhla ku Meyi ifumaneka nge 1 Jan.
eng_text: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Isithuba kwiindawo ezaziwa kakhulu, njengeBright Angel Campground emelene nePhantom Ranch, sizala zizicelo kusuku lokuqala zivulelel ukubhukisha indawo.
eng_text: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Kukho inani eliqingqiweyo leempepha-mvume zabo bazithanga xa befika, zona zifumaneka kwabo bafike kuqala.
eng_text: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Ukungena kuMazantsi eAfrika ngemoto yindlela emangalisayo yokubona bonke ubuhle bengingqi kuquka nokuya kwiindawo ekungafane kuyiwe kuzo ngabahambi.
eng_text: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Oku kungenzeka ngesithuthi esiqhelekileyo ngokuceba okuchanileyo kodwa inqwelo eyi 4x4 yeyona ikhuthazwayo kuba ingingqi ezinintsi zifikeleleka ngesithuthi esimavili ayi 4x4.
eng_text: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Ungalibali xa usenza amalungiselelo ukuba nangona uMzantsi Africa uzinzile akafani namanye amazwe akufuphi awekhonjalo.
eng_text: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Iimfuneko zeVisa kunye neendleko ziyahluka ngokwamazwe kwaye zichatshazelwa lilizwe ovela kulo.
eng_text: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Ilizwe ngalinye linemithetho eyahlukileyo efuna ukuba zeziphi izinto ezinyanzelekileyo ekufuneka zikhona emotweni.
eng_text: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: I-Victoria Falls, yidolophu ekwinxalenye esentshona eZimbabwe, ngaphesheya komda weLivingstone, eZambia kodwa kufutshane neBotswana.
eng_text: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Le dolophu isecaleni konxweme, kwaye ingowona umtsalane uphambili, kodwa le ndawo ithandwa ngabakhenkethi inika kokubini abo bafuna ukuzonwabisa kunye nabo bafuna ukubona iindawo amathuba amaninzi okuhlala ixesha elide.
eng_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Ngexesha lemvula (ngoNovemba ukuya kutsho ngoMatshi), amanzi aye esiba maninzi yaye iiNgxangxasi zibukeka ngendlela emangalisayo.
eng_text: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Nakanjani uzobamanzi ukuba uwela ibhulorho okanye uhamba ngeendlela ezijikela ngaseFalls.
eng_text: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Kwelinye icala, kungokuba ngokuchanileyo ubuninzi bamanzi buphakamile kakhulu kangangokuba ukubona kwakho Ingxangxasi kuyaphazamiseka- ngamanzi onke.
eng_text: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Ingcwba lika Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 kusenokwenzeka ukuba lelona ngcwaba lidumileyo kulamaThafa , ufanekiso ka Howard Carter's 1922 wokufumanisa ingcwaba phantse lisancwalile lekumkani eyayiselula.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Ngokuthelekiswa namanye amagcwaba obukumkani, kodwa, ingcwaba lika-Tutankhamun alithandeki, kuba lincinci kwaye alihonjiswa kakhulu.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Nabani na onomdla wokubona ubungqina bomonakalo owenziwe kwisidumbu esiqwayitiweyo ngoxa bekuzanywa ukusikhupha ebhokisini, uza kuphoxeka njengoko iyintloko namagxa kuphela ezibonakalayo.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Ubuncwane obabusengcwabeni abusekho kulo, kodwa bafuduselwa kwi-Egyptian Museum eCairo.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Abandwendweli abanexehsa elincinane kuya kuba bhetele ukuba bachithe ixesha labo ndawo yimbi.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: I-Phnom Krom, ikwi-12 km kumzantsi-ntshona we Siem Reap. Le tempile ephezu kwenduli yakhiwa ekupheleni kwenkulungwane yesithoba ngelixa lokulawula kuka Kumkani u-Yasovarman.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Ukukhanyi kangako kwetempile nokubukeka xa ujonge ngapha kwechibi iTonle Sap kwenza ukungazisoli ngonyuka le nduli.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Utyelelo kwindawo lungadityaniswa ngokuchuliweyo kunye nohambo ngesikhephe oluya echibini.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Kufuneka i-Angkor Pass ukuze ungene kwitempile, ngoko ke ungalibali ukuza nepasipothi yakho xa usiya kwi-Tonle Sap.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: IJerusalem sesona sixeko sikhulu kwaye ikwalikomkhulu lase-Israel, nangona amanye amazwe Ezizwe Ezimanyeneyo engayigqali njengekomkhulu lase-Israel.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Esi sixeko sakudala Sakwiinduli ZakwaYuda sinembali ebangela umdla yeminyaka yamawakawaka.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Isixeko singcwele kunqulo olwahlukahlukeneyo olunqula uthixo omnye - ubuYuda, ubuKrestu kunye nobuSilamsi yaye sisisazulu senkcubeko, sonqulo nesezinto ezinokwenza nothixo.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Ngenxa yokufuzisela kokholo kuledolophu, ingakumbi kwiindawo ezininzi kwingingqi yeDolophu Yakudala, i-Jerusalem yeyona ndawo enabavakashi eSirayeli.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: IJerusalem iinendawo ezininzi zembali, ezombiweyo kunye nezenkcubeko kunye noobhazabhaza beevenkile abagcweleyo, iikhefi kunye neendawo zokutyela.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: I-Ecuador ifuna ukuba abemi baseCuba bafumane isimemo ileta ngaphambi kokungena e-Ecuador ngokusebenzisa izikhululo zeenqwelomoya zamazwe aphesheya okanye kwiindawo zokungena kwimida.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Le leta kufuneka ibhaliswe ngokusemthethweni nguMphathiswa Wezangaphandle wase-Ecuador, kwaye ahambelane neemfuno ezithile.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Ezi mfaneleko zenzelwe ukuze zivumele ukuhamba phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Abemi baseCuba abaneempepha zobumi base-US bamele batyelele kumzi wozakuzo wase-Ecuador ukuze bakhululwe kwezi mfuno.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Ipasipothi yakho imele iphelelwe kwisithuba seenyanga eziyi-6 emva kohambo lwakho. Ukuba netikiti lokuya nokubuya/ukuya kwelinye ilzwe kuyafuneka ukuze ukwazi ukungqina ukuba uza kuhlala ixesha elingakanani.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Ukuthorisha kubiza kancinci kumaqela amakhulu, ngoko ukuba uhamba wedwa okanye ukunye nomhlobo omnye, zama ukudibana nabanye abantu nize nenze iqela labantu abane ukuya kwabathandathu ukuze nifumane amaxabiso ancitshisiweyo ngomntu ngamnye.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Kodwa ke, le nto ayimele ikuxhalabise kangako, kuba amaxesha amaninzi abakhenkethi bayatshintshatshintshwa ukuze bagcwalise iimoto.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Kubonakala ngathi yindlela yokuqhatha abantu ukubenza bakholwe ukuba kufuneka babhatale ngaphezulu.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Ephakamileyo kumantla eMachu Picchu yintaba enyukileyo, esoloko ibangela ukungaphumeleli kwemifanekiso.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Ikhangeleka isothusa xawusezantsi, futhi liqhina elimileyo elide, kodwa isininzi sabantu abasegazini bangalenza ngemizuzu eyi-45.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Amanyathelo amatye abekwe ecaleni kwendlela, kwaye kumacandelo anyukayo iintambo zentsimbi zinceda ngokubamba ngesandla.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Bathi, kulindela ukungakwazi ukuphefumla, uziqaphele indawo ezingamaxethuka, ikakhulu xa kumanzi, njengoko ingasuka ibenobungozi ngokukhawuleza.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Kukho umqolomba omncinane ekumele kudlulwe kuwo, usezantsi kakhulu kwaye umxinwa.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Ukubona iindawo nobomi bezilwanyana zase Galapagos yenziwa kakuhle ngesikhephe, kanye ngoluhlobo wenza ngalo u-Charles Darwin ngo 1835.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Ngaphezu kwe 60 yenqanawa zokuhamba zidlule kumanzi i Galapagos- ziphakathi ko 8 ukuya ku 100 lwenani lwabakhweli.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Abantu abaninzi babhukisha indawo yabo ngaphambi kwexesha (njengoko izikhephe zidla ngokuzala ngexesha lonyaka eliphezulu).
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Qiniseka ukuba iarhente oyibhukelayo yingcali yeGalapagos enolwazi olululo lweenqanawa ezahlukeneyo.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Oku kuza kuqinisekisa ukuba izinto ozithandayo kunye/okanye izinto ongazifuniyo zimataniswa nenqanawa efanelekileyo kubo.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Phambi kokufika kwabo base Spain ngesenturi ye 16th, iChile ekumantla yayiphansti kolawulo kwe Inca ngelixa ama Araucaniani ( Mapuche) ayehlala kumbindi nakumzantsi we Chile.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Abantu abayiMapuche, liqela lokugqibela labantu bomthonyama baseMelika abangazange bangene ngokupheleleyo phantsi kolawulo lweSpeyini de iChile yazimela geqe.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Nangona I-Chile yaba nenkululeko ngo 1810 (ngelixa leemfazwe zika Napoleonic ezashiya i-Spain singenaye urhulumente otsala imikhala iminyaka emide), uloyiso oluqinisekisiweyo kumaSpanish zange lufumaneke kwade kwaba ngumnyaka ka 1818.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: IDominican Republic (NgeSpanish: República Dominicana) lilizwe leCaribbean elikwihafu esempuma yesiqithi iHispaniola, esikwaseHaiti
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Ngaphandle kwelwandle ezisanti imhlophe nomhlaba ozintaba, ilizwe eli lilikhaya kwisixeko esidala samaMerika, ngoku eyinxalenye yeSanto Domingo.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Esi siqithi saqala ukuhlalwa ngamaTaínos kunye namaCaribbean. AmaCaribbean yayingabantu abathetha isiArawakan ababefike malunga ne-10 000 BCE.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Ngeminyakana embalwa nje ukulandela ukufika kwabakhangeli base-Europe, inani labantu baseTainos lalehlesiwe ngokubonakalayo ngabanqobi base-Spain.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: BeseFray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) phakathi kuka-1492 no-1498, aboyisi abangamaSpanish babulala iiTaínos ezimalunga ne-100 000.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: IJardín de la Unión. Le ndawo yakhiwa njengendawo evulekileyo yakudal yeminyaka yoo-17 yokuhlala oneengendi, apho iTemplo de San Diego kuphela kwesakhiwo esiseleyo.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Ngoku isebenza njenge central plaza, isoloko inezinto ezininzi eziqhubekayo, emini nasebusuku.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Kukho iqela lendawo zotyela ezingqunge igadi, kwaye emvakwemini nasemalanga kuxaphake ukubakho imidlalo yeqonga esuka kwi ntente esesiqikithini.
