eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: IiCallejon del Beso (we-Alley of the kiss). Iibhalkhoni ezimbini ezohlulwe nje ziisentimitha eziyi-69 likhaya lebali lakudala lothando.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Ngesenti nje ezimbalwa abanye abantwana bayakukubalisela ibali.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: I-Bowen Island luhambo oludumileyo losuku okanye uhambo lweempelaveki olunikezela nge-kayaking, ukuhamba intaba, iivenkile, iivenkile zokutyela, nokunye okuninzi.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Olu luntu lokwenyani lupha kwiHowe Sound ngaphandle nje kweVancouver, kwaye ifikeleleka ngokulula ngeeteksi zamanzi ezicwangcisiweyo ezisuka eGranville Island kwidolophu yaseVancouver.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Kwabo bonwabela imisebenzi yangaphandle, uhambo olonyusa uLwandle ukuya kwi-Sky luyimfuneko.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: I-Whistler (umgama wee iiyure eziyi-1.5 ukusukela e-Vancouver) iyabiza kodwa yaziwa kakhulu ngenxa yemidlalo yaseBusika yee-Olympics yango-2010.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Ebusika, mandelwa kukushushuluza okungoyiwayo e-mNtla Melika, kuze ngehlobo ulinge ukukhwelwa kweebhayisekile entabeni.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Iipemiti kufuneka zigcinwe kwangaphambili. Kuya kufuneka ube nepemiti yokuhlala ubusuku eSirena.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: ISirena kuphela kwesikhululo seRanger esibonelela ngendawo yokuhlala kunye nokutya okushushu ukongeza kwinkampu. ILa Leona, iSan Pedrillo, kunye neLos Patos zibonelela ngeenkampu kuphela ngaphandle kwenkonzo yokutya.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Unako ukufumana iipemithi zepakhi ngqo Kwisikhululo Soonogada sasePuerto Jiménez, kodwa amakhadi ekhredithi awamkelwa.
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: I The Park Service (MINAE) ayinikezi ngaphambi kwethuba imvume zepaki ezidlula kwinyanga enye phambi kokufika.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: I-CafeNet El Sol inikezela ngeenkonzo zokubhukisha ngexabiso leUS$30, okanye i$10 yosuku olunye; iinkcukacha zikwiphepha elingaphandle labo iCorcovado.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Iziqithi zase-Cook lilizwe leziqithi elimanyane ngokukhululekileyo ne-New Zealan, ese-Polynesia, esiphakathini ku-Mzantsi Wolwandle le-Pacific.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Iyi archipelago ene-15 yeziqithi ezisasazeke kumgama oyi-2.2 million km2 yolwandle.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Iziqithi zinexesha lommandla elinye neHawaii, ngoko ngamanye amaxesha kuthiwa zi-“Hawaii down under”.
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Nangona incinci, ikhumbuza iindwendwe esele zindala zaseHawaii phambi kwabemi ngaphandle kwazo zonke iihotele ezinkulu zabakhenkethi kunye nolunye uphuhliso.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Iziqithi zase-Cook azina zixeko kodwa zibunjwa ngeziqithi eziyi-15 ezohlukileyo. Eziyintlokoonayi-Rarotonga kunye ne-Aitutaki.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Kumazwe aphuhlileyo kulemihla, ukunikeza ngenkozo ze bed and breakfast inyungeke yaba kwizinga lobugcisa.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Kwicala eliphezulu, kucacile ukuba izinto ezimbini eziphambili iiB&B ezikhuphisana ngazo: yindawo yokulala nesidlo sakusasa.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Ngokunjalo ke, kwezona ndawo zintle , umntu uyakwazi ukuba afumane eyona nto yokulala isemagqabini, mhlawumbi ingubo eyenziwe ngesandla okanye ibhedi yakudala.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Isidlo sasekuseni siseno banezinto zehlobo zalongingqi okanye isidlo esithandwa ngumni.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Ukuseta kunokuba sisakhiwo esidala esinembali ngempahla ye-antique, indawo enezinto zokucoca umzimba kunye nedama lokubhukuda.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Ukungena emotweni yakho uthabathe uhambo olude lungumceli mngeni olula.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Ngokungafaniyo zezithuthi ezikhulu, kumele ukuba sele uqhelile ukuqhuba imoto yakho kwaye uyakwazi nokohluleka kwayo.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Ukumisa intente kwindawo yomntu okanye edolophini, nokuba ingakanani, kunokutsala umdla ongafunekiyo.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Ngelifutshane, ukusebenzisa imoto yakho ngeyona ndlela ibhethele yokuhamba kodwa kunqabile ukuba isetyenziselwe "ukukhempisha".
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Ukukhempisha ngemoto kunokwenzeka ukuba unayo i-minivan enkulu, i-SUV, iSedan okanye iStation Wagon esinezitulo ezihlayo.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Ezinye iihotele zinelifa elivela kwiminyaka yobudala yegolide yoololiwe abomphunga kunye nelwandle; Phambi kweMfazwe yesibini (II) yeHlabathi, ngenkulungwane ye-19 okanye yokuqala yama-20.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Ezi hotele kulapho izityebi kunye nantu abadumileyo baloo mihla bebehlala khona, kwaye zazihlala zisitya kamnandi ibe zisonwabela ubomi basebusuku.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Ifanishala yakudala, ukunqaba kwezinto onokuzisebenzisa zangoku nokuguga kakuhle zonke ezo, zizinto zazo.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Nangonga zidla ngokuba zezabucala, ziye ngamanye amaxesha zihlalise intloko zamazwe ezindwendweleyo nezinye izihlonipheki.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Umhambi onemfumba yemali unokucinga ngokujikeleza ngenqwelomoya kwilizwe liphela, aqhekezwe kukuhlala kuninzi lwezi hotele.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Uthungelwano lotshintshiselwano ngomoya wokubuka iindwendwe ngumbutho odibanisa abahambi nabantu basezidolophini bazivizithelayo.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Ukujoyina inetwork enjalo kudla nje ngokufuna ukuba uzalise iform ekwiinternethi; nangona ezinye inetwork zinika okanye zifuna okongezelelweyo ukuqisekiswa.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Uluhlu lwababuki zindwendwe abafumaneka luye lwenziwe lufumaneke luprintiwe okanye kwi-intanethi, ngamanye amaxesha luba nezimvo kunye noncomelo lwabantu ebebekhe bahlala apho.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: ICouchsurfing yasekwa ngoJanuwari 2004 emva kokuba umdwelisi weenkqubo zekhompyutha uCasey Fenton efumene inqwelomoya ngexabiso eliphantsi eIceland kodwa engenayo indawo yokuhlala.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Wathumela i-imeyile kubafundi beyunivesithi yendawo kwaye wafumana inani elinamandla kakhulu lokufumana indawo indawo yokuhlala yamahhala.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Iihosteli zilungiselelwe ikakhulu abantu abatsha- undwendwe lwabo luphakathi kweninyaka emashumi Mabini- kodwa uyakwazi ukufumana abahambi abadala apho ngokunjalo.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Iintsapho ezinabantwana azifane zibekho, kodwa ezinye iihostele ziyabavumela kumagumbi abucala.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Isixeko saseBeijing e-China siza kuba sisixeko esiza kubamba iMidlalo yeOlimpiki yasebusika ngo-2022, nesiza kuyenza isixeko sokuqala ukubamba ii-Olimpiki zasehlotyeni nezasebusika.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: I-Beijing iza kubamba umnyhadala wokuvula nowokuvala kunye neziganeko zemidlalo yomkhence owenziwe ngaphakathi.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Eminye iminyhadala yeskiing iya kuba kwingingqi yase Taizicheng ski eZhangjiakou, malunga ne 220 km (140 miles) ukusuka e Beijing.
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Iitempile ezininzi zineminyhadala ebanjwa qho Ngonyaka ukususela ngoNovemba ukuya kuphela Phakathi ngoMeyi, kwaye yohlukana ngokwekhalenda yetempile nganye.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Imibhiyozo eminizni yetempile ibhiyozelwa njengenxalenye yesikhumbuzo okanye imini yokuzalwa kothixo okhoyo okanye nasiphi na isiganeko esayanyaniswa netempile.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Imibhiyozo yetempile yamaKerala inikeza umdla kakhulu xa uyibona, itsho ngemihombiso eqhelekileyo yeendlovu,umculo we orchestra neminye imibhiyozo.
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: I-World’s Fair (eyaziwa ngokuba yi-World Exposition okanye ngamafutshanye i-Expo) ngumthendeleko omkhulu wobugcisa bamazwe nezesayensi.
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Amazwe athatha inxaxheba enza imiboniso yobugcisa kunye neyezemfundo kumaqonga esizwe ukuze abonise iingxaki zehlabathi okanye abonise inkcubeko yelizwe lawo okanye imbali yawo.
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Ukuboniswa Kokulima Kwamazwe Ngamazwe ngamatheko akhethekileyo abonisa ngeentyatyambo, imiyezo kunye nantoni na enokwenza izityalo.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Nangono bekumele ukuba zibe rhoqo ngonyaka (lo gama nje zikumazwe awahlukahlukeneyo), enyanisweni akunjalo.
eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Le micimbi iqhele ukubakho kangangeenyanga ezintathu ukuya kwezintandathu, ibe ibanjelwa kwiindawo ezinobukhulu obungekho ngaphantsi kweehektare eziyi-50
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Zininzi iifomathi zeefilimu ezahlukeneyo ezisetyenzisiweyo kwiminyaka edlulileyo. Ifilimu esemgangathweni engama-35 mm (36 ngama-24 mm ) yeyona ixhaphake kakhulu.
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Inokuzaliswa ngokulula ngokulula ukuba uyaphelelwa, kwaye inike isisombululo ngokuthelekisa neDSLR yangoku.
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Ezinye ii-camera ezine eziyilentlobo ephakathi endaweni yayo zisebenzisa intlobo ye-6 ngo 6 cm, ngokuchana ucwethe I-56 nge 56 mm o-negative.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Oku kunika irizolushini ephantse iphindwe kanei kunaleyo ye-35 mm negethivi (3136 mm2 ngokuchasene nama-864).
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Ubomi basendle bobona bucela umngeni kumfoti, kufuneka abengxubevange yethamsanqa,ukunyamezela, amava kunye nezixhobo ezifanelekileyo.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Ukufota izilwanyana zasendle kudla ngokuthathwa kancinci, kodwa ngokufanayo neefoto eziqhelekileyo, umfanekiso uyakwazi ukubonisa izinto ezininzi.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Ukufota izilwanyana kudla ngokufuna ilensi eyi-telephoto, nangona izinto ezifana neentaka ezininzi okanye izinto ezincinci zifuna iilensi ezahlukileyo.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Izilwanyana ezintle azininzi kunzima ukuzifumana,neepaki ngamanye amaxesha ziba nemithetho ngokuthatha imifaanekiso ngenjongo zokushishina.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Izilwanyana zasendle zingaba noburhalarhume okanye zibe neentloni. Indawo ingabanda, ibe shushu okanye ingahlaleki.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Umhlaba uneelwimi ezahlukeneyo ezingaphezu kwe-5000, kuquka ngaphezulu kwamashumi amabini athethwa zizigidi ezingama-50 okanye ngaphezulu.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Amazwi abhaliweyo kudla ngokuba lula ukuwaqonda kunamazwi athethwayo. Oku kuyinyaniso xa kuthethwa ngeedilesi, ezidla ngokuba nzima ukuzibiza ngendlela eqondakalayo.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Izizwe ezininzi ziyasazi kakuhle isiNgesinangaphezulu koko ungakulindela ulwazi oluncinci ikakhulu kwabo baselula.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Yiba nombono, ukuba uyakwazi, i-Mancunian, um-Boston, um-Jamaica kunye ne-nom-Sydney behleli etafileni kwisidlo sangokuhlwa kwindawo yokutyela eToronto.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Bonwabisana ngobaliselana ngamabali alapho umntu ngamnye avela khona, bewabalisa bethetha ngelizwi lalapho basuka khona nangelamaqela asekuhlaleni.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Ukuthenga ukutya evenkileni yeyona ndlela ingabiziyo yokuzondla. Kungekho mathuba okupheka, ukhetho lusingisele ekutyeni okuthengwa kuphekiw.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Kuye kusanda ukubona iisuphamakethi ziya zisiba namacandelo awahlukahlukeneyo okutya okusele kuvuthiwe. Ezinye zide zibonelele ne-microwave okanye ezinye iindlela zokushushubeza ukutya,
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Kwamanye amazwe okanye iintlobo zeevenkile kukho ubuncinci indawo yokutyela enye emehlweni abantu, ihlala inendawo engacwangciswanga ngamaxabiso afikelelekayo.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Yenza kwaye uphathe iikopi zepolisi ye-inshorensi yakho kunye neenkcukacha zakho zoqhagamshelwanoi.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Kufuneka babonakalise I emeyile zomsholensi kunye nemnombolo zehlabathi zengcebiso/okanye zogunyaziso nokwenza amabango.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Funeke ubenekopi kumthwalo wakho futhi kumnathazwe (zi-email-ele ufake iphepha, okanye uyigcine kwi-"cloud").
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Ukuba uhamba ne laptop okanye ithabhlethi, gcina ikopi kuvimba wayo okanye kwi diski( evuleka ngaphandle kwe intanethi).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Nika ipolisi/iikopi zoqhagamshelwano kwizihlobo ohamba nazo kunye nezalamane okanye izihlobo ezisemva ekhaya ezikulungeleyo ukunceda.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Moose (ephinde yaziwe njenge elk) azimfuzo yocinezelo, kodwa ziyakuthi zizikhusele ukuba zikrokrela uloyikiso.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Xa abantu bengayiboni inyamakazi inokuba yingozi, banokusondela kufutshane kakhulu kwaye bazibeka emngciphekweni.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Sela iziselo ezinotywala ngokulinganiselweyo. Utywala buchaphazela abantu ngokwahlukeneyo, ukwazi ummiselo wakho kubalulekile.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Iziganeko ezinokwenzeka ethubeni kwimpilo ezibangelwa kukusela kakhulu kukonakala kwesibindi kunye nokungaboni kanti nokufa. Kunobungozi mpela xa usela utywala obenziwa ngokungekho mthethweni.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Utywala bezipirithi obungekho mthethweni bunganezinto ezingacocekanga ezininzi kuquka imethanol. Yona enokubangela ukuphanyaka kwamehlo okanye ukufa nokuba iselwa ngamathamo amancinane.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Izipeksi zamanye amazwe zinokubiza imali encincane kwamanye amazwe, ngokukhethekileyo kumazwe angafumanga apho abantu bebhatalwa imali encinci.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Cinga ngokwenza uvavanyo lwamehlo ekhaya, ngakumbi ukuba i-inshurensi iza kulubhatalela, uze uze .
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: I-frames zikanokutsho nezidumileyo ezikhoyo kwiindawo ezinjalo zineengxaki ezimbini; ezinye zinokuba yimigunyathi, kwaye ezona zifunyenwe kwamanye amazwe zinokubiza kakhulu kunasekhaya.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Ikofu yeyona mveliso kurhwetywa ngayo ehlabathini, yaye ungafumana iintlobo ezahlukahlukeneyo kummandla ohlala kuwo.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Nangona kunjalo, kwihlabathi liphela, zininzi iindlela ezahlukahlukeneyo zokuphunga ikofu ezimele zizanywe.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Ukungea kumwonyo (okanye: ukungena kumwonyo) kukuya emazantsi omwonyo, osenokuba womile okanye ugcwele amanzi.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: I-Canyoning idibanisa indlela zokuqubha, ukukhwela nokuxhumaxhuma—kodwa ifuna ithutyana elincinci lokuqeqeshwa okanye ukwakheka komzimba ukuze uyiqalise (xa ithelekaniswa nokunyuka ematyeni, i-scuba diving okanye i-alpine skiing, ngomzekelo).
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Ukuhaykha kukuzixakekisa phandle okuquka ukuhambahamba emathafeni endalo, unambela kumajikojiko.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Ukuhamba ngenyawo kubandakanya imigama engaphantsi kwemayile ukuya kwemide enokuqukunjelwa ngosuku olunye.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Uhambo olude kwiindledlana ekulula ukuhamba kuzo nalo kufuneka ululungiselele, ibe umntu osemandleni angephi naye angalonwabela.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Iintsapho ezinabantwana abancinane kungafuneka zenze amalungiselelo angakumbi, kodwa ukuchitha usuku ngaphandle kunokwenzeka nokuba kukho iintsana okanye abantwana abangekaqali sikolo.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Kwihlabathi lonke, kukho phantse ama-200 kwimibutho yabakhenkethi ebalekayo. Uninzi lwazo lusebenza ngokuzimeleyo.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Ongene ezihlangwini zeAGlobal Running Tours, i-Go Running Tours ilungelelanisa uninzi lwababoneleli ababonayo kumazwekazi amane.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Ngenxa yokuba neengcambu Zokuqhuba Ukhenketho eBarcelo Nokuqhuba olwaseCopenhageni, yakhawuleza yajoyinwa Ekuqhubeni Ukhenketho ePrague nakwezinye iindawo.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Zininzi izinto ekufuneka uzithathele ingqalelo ngaphambili naxa usiya kwenye indawo.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Xa ukuhambo, lindela izinto zingafani "nasekhayeni lakho". Isimilo, imithetho, ukutya, ukuxinana kweendlela, ukuhlala, amazinga, ulwimi nokunjalo kuzakude kohluke ekuhambheni xakuthelekiswa nalapho uhlala khona.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Yinto le ekufuneka usoloko uyigcine engqondweni, ukuze ungaphoxeki okanye ukuphelelwa ngumdla wendlela abantu balapha abenza izinto ngayo.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Iiarhente zokucwangcisa uhambo bezikho ukususela kwinkulungwane ye-19. Iarhente yokucwangcisa uhambo idla ngokuba lukhetho oluhle kuhambo oluquka izinto umhambi angakhange azenze, inkcubeko, ulwimi okanye amazwe ahluphekayo.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Nangona iinkonzo ezininzi zizimisele ukwamkela isininzi semilungiselelo yokuhlala, iiarhente ezininzi zinobuchwephesha kwiintlobo ezithile zohambho, amaxabiso athile or iindawo zokufikela.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Kungangcono xa usebenzisa i-agent eqhele ukubhukisha ukhenketho oluyelele kolwakho.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Jonga ukuba loluphi uhambo olukhuthazwa yiarhente, nokuba ikwiwebhusayithi okanye kwifestile yevenkile.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Ukuba ufuna ukuhamba hamba amazwe ngaphandle kokudleka kakhulu, ukuba kuyimfuneko, indlela yokuphila okanye njengocelo mngeni, zikhona iindlela zokwenza oko.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Ngokusisiseko, ziwela kwiindidi ezimbini: Usebenza ngoxa ukuhambo okanye unciphise iindleko zakho. Eli nqaku lithetha ngale yokugqibela.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Abobazimiseleyo ukunikezela ubuntofontofo, ixesha nokulindeleka ukwenzela ukwehlisa amaxabiso ukusondela kunothi, jonga elona xabiso lincinci esinalo.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Ingcebiso ithatha ukuba abahambi ababi, bengangeni ngaphandle kwemvume, abathathi nxaxheba kwimakethi engekho mthethweni, abaceli, okanye baxhaphaze abanye abantu ukuze bafumane inzuzo.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Indawo yotshekisho lwabafuduki idla ngokuba yindawo yokuqala ukumiswa xa sukuba usihla kwinqwelo moya, inqanawa okanye nasiphi na isithuthi.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Kuye kwenziwe uhlolo koololiwe abahamba ngapha kwemida yelizwe, yaye umele ubeneSazisi esisemthethweni xa ukhwela abo loliwe.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Koololiwe ekulalwayo kubo, iipasipoti zinokuqokelelwa ngumqhubi ukuze ungaphazanyiswa ebuthongweni bakho.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Ubhaliso sisidingo esongezelelweyo esifunekayo kwinkqubo yokufumana ivisa. Kwamanye amazwe, funeka ubhalise ubukho bakho nedilesi yalapho uhlala khona kwabasemagunyeni asekuhlaleni.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Oku kungafuna ugcwalise ifomu emapoliseni asekuhlaleni okanye utyelele iifofisi ezigunyazisa ukungena nokuphuma elizweni.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Kumazwe amanintsi analomthetho, iihotela zasekuhlaleni ziyakwenza ubhaliso (qiniseka ukuba uyabuza).
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Kwezinye iimeko, ngabo bahlala kwiindawo ezingezizo ezabahambi kuphela ekufuneka babhalise. Sekunjalo, oku kwenza umthetho ungaqondakali, ngoko zama ukufumanisa ngaphambi kwexesha.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: I-Architecture ijongene nokudizayna nokwakha izakhiwo. I-archictecture yendawo idla ngokuba yiyo etsala abakhenkethi.
eng_text: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Izakhiwo ezininzi zintle kakhulu xa uzibukele ukwindawo ekrelekrele ephakamileyo okanye kwisakhiwo esiphakamileyo bubuhle beliso bodwa.
eng_text: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Uyilo buhambelana nezinye iimfundiso njengoyilo lwedolophu, ubunjineli bezakhiwo, ubugcisa bohombiso, ukuhombisakwngaaphakathi kwaye nokulungisa umhlaba ukuze kufakwe izityalo.
eng_text: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Ngenxa yokuba zikude kangakanani ii-pueblos, awuyi kuba nakho ukufumana isixa esibalulekileyo sobomi bobusuku ngaphandle kokuya eAlbuquerque okanye eSanta Fe.
eng_text: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Sekunjalo, phantse zonke iikhasino ezichazwe kolu luhlu lungentla ziyanikisa ngeziselo, kwaye uninzi lwazo zizisa amagama aziwayo kwezolonwabo (ikakhulu ezi zinkulu zingqonge i-Albuquerque ne Santa Fe).
eng_text: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Lumka: iibhari zakwiidolophu ezincinane azisoloko zisiba ziindawo ezifanelekileyo zokuya kubantu abasuka ngaphandle kwephondo.
eng_text: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Enye into, emntla New Mexico kuneengxaki ezinkulu zokuqhuba kwabantu benxilile, kwaye aba bantu banxilileyo baba linani eliphezulu kwiidolophu ezincinane ezineebhari.
eng_text: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: iMurals engafunekiyo okanye isikripthi esaziwa ngokuba yigraffiti.
eng_text: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Ngelixa kukude kwinto yanamhlanje, uninzi lwabantu mhlawumbi luyidibanisa nolutsha olonakalisa impahla kawonke-wonke kunye neyabucala kusetyenziswa ipeyinti yokutshiza.
eng_text: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Kodwa ke, kule mihla yethu sele kukho abazobi begraffiti, iminyhadala yegraffiti namadonga "asemthethweni" ayo. Imizobo yeGraffitis ela imele ukubonisa imisebenzi yokuyila kunokuthegwa okungafundekiyo.
eng_text: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Ukukwazi ukuphosa i-boomerang sisakhono esixhaphakileyo abakhenkethi abaninzi abafuna ukuba naso.
eng_text: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Ukuba ubawela ukufunda ukugibisela iboomerang ezophinda ibuyele esandleni sakho, funeke ufumane iboomerang ekwaziyo ukubuya.
eng_text: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Uninzi lwee-boomerang ezikhoyo e-Australia enyanisweni azibuyi. Kungcono ukuba abaqalayo bangazami ukuphosa moya
eng_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Ukutya kweHangi kuphekwa kumngxunya owenziwe emhlabeni.
eng_text: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Lo mngxuma usenokuba utshiswa ngamatye ashushu omlilo, okanye kwezinye indawo i-geothermal yomlilo yenza indawo ethile yomhlaba itshise ngokwendalo.
eng_text: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Ihangi-umngxumo onamatye ashushu- amaxesha amaninzi isetyenziselwa ukurowusta ukutya okuqhelekileyo.
eng_text: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Iindawo ezininzi eRotorua zinako ukutya ekuthiwa yihangi kona okuphekwe ngobushushu bomhlaba, ngoxa enye intlobo yehangi ifumaneka eChristchurch, eWellington nakwezinye iindawo.
eng_text: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: IMetroRail ineeklasi ezimbini koololiwe babakhweli eKapa neziphaluka: iMetroPlus (ekwabizwa ngokuba yiKlasi yokuQala) neMetro (ebizwa ngokuba yiKlasi yesiThathu).
eng_text: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: I-MetroPlus itofotofo kancinci yaye ayigcwali kakhulu kodwa ikwabiza ngakumbi, nangona ixabisa ngaphantsi kwamaxabiso emetro eYurophu.
eng_text: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Uloliwe ngamnye unamakhareji eMetroPlus neMetro; aweMetroPlus asoloko esekupheleni kukaloliwe kufutshane naseKapa.
eng_text: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Ukukhathalela abanye -Ungaze uyeke ukuzijonga iibhegi zakho, ngakumbi xa uwela imida yamazwe aphesheya.
eng_text: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Ungazifumana sele usetyenziswa njengomphathi weziyobisi ngaphandle ungayazi wena lonto, nto leyo eza kukufaka engxakini enkulu.
eng_text: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Le ifaka ukufola, kwaye nezinja-ezinukisa izidakamiswa zingasetyenziswa naongomphi na umzuzu.
eng_text: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Amanye amazwe anezohlwayo ezigqithileyo nakwityala lokuqala; Ezi zibandakanya izigwebo zentolongo ezingaphezu kweminyaka elishumi okanye ukufa.
eng_text: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Amasaka angahoywanga alicham lamasela futhi atsala iliso labomthetho abaxhalele iziqhushumbhisi.
eng_text: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Ekhaya, ngenxa yokudibana rhoqo neentsholongwane zalapha ekhaya, amathuba aphezulu kakhulu ukuba sele uzikhusele kuzo.
eng_text: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Koda kwezinye indawo ehlabathini, apho intsholongwane yefauna intsha kuni, nikude ekubeni ningazifumana nisezingxakini.
eng_text: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Kwakhona, kwimozulu eshushu ibhaktheriya iyakhawuleza ukukhula yaye iyakwazi ukuphila ixesha elide ngaphandle komzimba.
eng_text: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Yiyo ke loo nto izibetho zikaDelhi Belly, isiqalekiso sikaFaro, uMbuyekezo kaMontezuma, kunye nabahlobo babo abaninzi.
eng_text: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Kanye njengokuba iingxaki zokuphefumla ziqhelekile kwiindawo ezibandayo, iingxaki zesisu ziqhelekile kwiindawo ezishushu yaye amaxesha amaninzi ziyakruqula kuphela aziyongozi kangako.
eng_text: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Ukuba uya kwilizwe elisakhulayo okokuqala- okanye kwindawo entsha ehlabathini- ungakuthathi kancinci ukothuswa sisthethe sendawo.
eng_text: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Baninzi abahambi abaqhelileyo abaye bohlulwa kukuhamba umhlaba wonke apho ukutshintsha kwenkcubeko nokuba kuncinane kuye kwenza kungabi saba mnandi.
eng_text: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Ingakumbi ngeentsuku zakho zokuqala, cinga ngokuchitha imali kwizitayile zaseNtshona kunye - neehotele ezisemgangathweni, ukutya kunye neenkonzo ukuze zikuncede uqhelane nendawo.
eng_text: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Musa ukulala kumatrasi okanye iphedi emhlabeni kwiindawo ongazaziyo izilwanyana zayo.
eng_text: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Ukuba uzakukempisha ngaphandle, uphathe ikhemp cot okanye I hammock ukuze ikukhusele kwinyoka, nezigcawu njalo njalo.
eng_text: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Zalisa ikhaya lakho ngekofu ephucukileyo kusasa kunye neti ye chamomile ephumzayo ebusuku.
eng_text: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Xa uhlala kwindawo yokuhlala, unexesha lokuziphatha kwaye uthathe imizuzu embalwa eyongezelelweyo ukwenza into ekhethekileyo.
eng_text: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Ukuba unemvakalelo zokufumanisa, thabatha ithuba lokwenza incindi okanye ucubhe ezicujwayo:
eng_text: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Mhlambi uzakufumana isidlo esibandayo onokusenza njengesidlo sakusasa xa ubuyele kwimo yakho yesiqhelo.
eng_text: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Ukuba uhlala esixekweni esineenkcubeko ezahlukeneyo zokusela, yiya ezibharini okanye kwiindawo zentselo ongaziqhelanga.
eng_text: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Kwabo bangaqhelekanga namagama ezonyango, agama athi ukosuleleka nelithi ukusasazeka awathethi nto enye.
eng_text: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Isifo esosulelayo seso sibangelwa yintsholongwane, njengentsholongwane, ibhaktiriya, ukungunda okanye ezinye izifunxi-gazi.
eng_text: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Isifo esosulelayo, sisifo esisasazeka ngokulula xa ukwindawo umntu onaso akuyo.
eng_text: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Oorhulumente abaninzi bafuna iindwendwe ezingena, okanye abemi abaphumayo kumazwe abo bagonyelwe izifo ezininzi.
eng_text: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Ezi zinto zifunekayo amaxesha amaninzi zixhomekeka ekubeni umhambi seye kwawaphi amazwe okanye leliphi ilizwe afuna ukuya kulo.
eng_text: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Enye yezinto ezigqamileyo nge-Charlotte, e-North Carolina, kungenxa yokuba iintsapho zinokukhetha okuninzi apho.
eng_text: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Abahlali abasuka kwezinye iindawo bathanda ukuchaza ububele bamakhaya njengesona sizathu sokuya apho, kwaye nabakhenkethi bafumana isixeko silula nokusonwabela apho kukho nabantwana.
eng_text: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Kule minyaka iyi-20 idlulileyo, izinto ezifanele abantwana onokukhetha kuzo eMntla weCharlotte ziye zanda kakhulu.
eng_text: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Iintsapho zaseCharlotte azidli ngokusebenzisa iiteksi, nangona ziye zizisebenzise phantsi kweemeko ezithile.
eng_text: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Kukho intlawuliso yokukhwelisa abakhweli abadlule ku-2, ke olu khetho lunokuba duru kakhulu kunokuba luyimfuneko.
eng_text: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: i-Antarctica yeyona ndawo ibandayo Ehlabathini, futhi ingqonge i-Pole yasemazntsi.
eng_text: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Ukutyelelwa kubakhenkethi kuyabiza, kufuna amandla omzimba, anokwenzeka kuphela ehlotyeni ngo-Novemba, kwaye ikakhulu kunikelwe umda kwiPeninsula, Islands kunye neRoss Sea.
eng_text: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Amawaka amajoni ahlala apha ngehlobo kwiindawo eziphantse zibe ngamashumi amane anesibhozo.
eng_text: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Umphakathi we-Antarctica yindawo ephakamileyo egqunywe ngumkhence ofikelela kwiikhilomitha eziyi-2 ukuya kweziyi-3.
eng_text: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Ngamanye amaxesha kubakho ukhenketho olukhethekileyo olwenziwa ngenqwelo moya, ukuze kuziswe abanyuki ntaba okanye kufikwe kwi-Pole, yona enendawo enkulu yokufikela.
eng_text: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: I South Pole Traverse (okanye i Highway) ikumgama we 1600 km trail ukusuka kwisitishi i McMurdo kulwandle I Ross Sea ukuya kwi Pole.
eng_text: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Ikhephu lakhona eliqokeleleneyo neqabakaelizeleyo liphawulwe ngeflags. Kungahambeka kuphela ngeteletele ezikhethekileyo, ezinezileji ezinepetula nako konke.
eng_text: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Oku akuyonto ilunge kakhulu ngenxa yokuba umzila kufuneka uthathe ixesha elide ujikeleze iiNtaba zeTransantarctic ukuze ufike kwithafa.
eng_text: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Esona sizathu seengozi ebusika ziindlela ezityibilikisayo, iindlela zokuhamba (indlela zabantu) futhi ingakumbi iziteps.
eng_text: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Ubuncinane, udinga izihlangu ezinesoli efanelekileyo. Izihlangu zasehlotyeni zidla ngokutyibilika kumkhenkce nakwikhephu, yaye nezinye iibhutsi zobusika zikhe zingafaneleki.
eng_text: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Ipateni kufuneka ibe nzulu ngokwaneleyo, i-5 mm (1/5 intshi) okanye nangaphezulu, kwaye izinto zithambe ngokwaneleyo kumaqondo obushushu abandayo.
eng_text: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Ezinye iibhutsi zinee-studs kwaye kukho izixhobo ezongeziweyo ezongeziweyo zeemeko ezimtyibilizi, ezilungele izihlangu ezininzi kunye neebhutsi, zenzelwe izithende okanye izithende kunye nangaphantsi.
eng_text: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: IIchops funeke zibephantsi zibesixwexwe. Isanti, igrabile okanye ityiwa (isodiyam khlorhayidi) ifane isakazwe ezindleleni okanye kwindlela zokuphucula umtsalane.
eng_text: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Inyikima yodaka ayiyonto engekho sesiqhelweni; amajikojiko ayintaba abamba oko kuncinane, ukuze olunintsi udaka luhle njengenyikima yodaka.
eng_text: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Ingxaki yinto yokuba ikhephu luncangathi, ngoku ludinga ukuchukunyiswa ukuze lehle, futhi nekhephu elehlayo lingachukumeza elinye.
eng_text: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Ngamanye amaxesha isiganeko sokuqala sesingunobangela lilanga elishushubeza ikhephu, ngamanye amaxesha kukuwa kwekhephu, kwamanye amaxesha zizinto zokwemvelo, ngabantu amaxesha amaninzi.
eng_text: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Inkanyamba ngumoya ojikelezayo oxineneyo ophantsi kakhulu, ufunxa umoya ojikeleze ngaphakathi nangaphezulu.
eng_text: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Zenza umoya ovuthuza ngamandla (ngokuqhelekileyo, ofikelela ku-100-200 wemaliye ngeyure) ibe unokuphakamisa izinto ezisindayo uze uhambe nazo njengoko isitshingitshane sihamba.
eng_text: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Ziqala ngathi zizihluzo eziphuma kumafu esaqhwithi kwaye zijika zibe “ziinkanyamba” xa zifika emhlabeni.
eng_text: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Ababoneleli be-VPN (inethiwekhi yabucala yeintanethi) yeyona ndlela ilungileyo yokuphumela ngaphaya kokubini ukubekwa esweni ngabezopolitiko nokuthengiswa kwe-IP-geofiltering.
eng_text: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Zingaphezulu kwii-proxy zeweb ngenxa yezizathu eziliqela: Ziyaphinda zizifake endleleni zonke izinto ezikwi-Intanethi, azipheleli nje ku-http.
eng_text: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Ngokwesiqhelo banikezela nge-bandwidth ephezulu kunye nomgangatho ongcono wenkonzo. Zibhalwe ngokufihliweyo kwaye ngenxa yoko kunzima ukuzihlola.
eng_text: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Iinkampani zeendaba ziqhele ukuxoka ngenjongo yoku, zisithi oku “kwenzelwe ukuthintela ubumfihlo.”
eng_text: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Ngapha koko, iikhowudi zommandla azinampembelelo kukhuphelo olungekho mthethweni; ikopi encinci yediski iya kudlala kakuhle nakwesiphi na isixhobo apho unqontsonqa we diski angadlala khona.
eng_text: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Eyona njongo iyintloko kukunika ezo nkampani ulawulo olungakumbi phezu kweemarike zazo; konke oku kungokwenza imali.
eng_text: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Ngenxa yokuba iifowuni zihanjiswa nge-intanethi akuyomfuneko ukuba usebenzise inkampani yefowuni ekwindawo ohlala kuyo okanye apho uhambela khona.
eng_text: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Akukho mfuneko yokuba ufumane inombolo yendawo ohlala kuyo; Ungafumana uqhagamshelo lwe-Intanethi kwi-Intanethi endle yenkukhu, eAlaska kwaye ukhethe inombolo ethi useArizona enelanga.
eng_text: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Amaxesha amaninzi, kufuneka uthenge ecaleni inombolo yazwenibanzi evumela iifowuni ezisebenzisa i-PTSN ukuba zikufowunele. Xa inombolo ofowunelwa kuyo ibalulekile kubantu abakufowunelayo
eng_text: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Ii-apps zokutolika ngoko nangoko imibhalo, ii-applikayshini ezikwaziyo ukutolika iimibhalo emide yolunye ulwimi ngolunye ulwimi.
eng_text: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Ezinye I applications kolu luhlu zikwazi nokuguqulela okubhaliweyo ngalwimi zimbi ngesayns okanye ezinye iiobjects xa umsebenzisi ekhomba ismartphone sakhe kwezo objects.
eng_text: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Iinjini zokuguqulela ziphucuke kakhulu, ibe ngoku ziphantse zikunike iinguqulelo ezichanileyo (azifane zikunike ezingavakaliyo), kodwa ke kusafuneka ilungiswe, njengoko zizesenokukunika inguqulelo engeyiyo tu.
eng_text: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Enye yee-app eziphambili ezingena kule khategori ngu-Google Translate, evumela ukuguqulela ngaphandle koqhagamshelwano kwi-intanethi emva kokuba idatha yolwimi olufunwayo iye yadawunlowudwa.
eng_text: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Ukusebenzisa I apps ze GPS kwisamrtphone sakho singaba yeyona Ndlela elula nefikelelekayo ukuze uhlolahlole xa ungekho kwilizwe lakho.
eng_text: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Inokonga imali ngokuthenga iimephu ezintsha zeGPS, okanye isixhobo esizimeleyo seGPS okanye ukuqesha enye kwinkampani eqeshisa ngemoto.
eng_text: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Ukuba awunalo uqhagamshelo lwedatha kwifowuni yakho, okanye xa luphume kuluhlu, ukusebenza kwayo kunokuba ncinci okanye kungafumaneki.
eng_text: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Zonke iivenkile zasekuhlaleni zigcwele iintlobo ezahlukeneyo zamakhadi okufowuna asele egcwaliswe ngemali nanokusetyenziswa kwiifowuni zikawonke wonke okanye kwiifowuni eziqhelekileyo.
eng_text: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Ngelixa amakhadi amaninzi ekulungele ukufowna naphina, amanye agxile ekunikezeleni amaxabiso okufowuna afanelekileyo kumaqela athile amazwe.
eng_text: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Ukufikelela kwezi nkonzo kudla ngokuba xa kusetyenziswa inombolo yasimahla enokufonelwa ziifowuni ezininzi ngaphandle kokubhatala.
eng_text: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Imithetho malunga nokuthabatha imifanekiso ikwayimithetho ebhekiselele ekurekhodeni ividiyo, nokunye.
eng_text: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Ukuba ukuthabatha nje ifoto yento akuvumelekanga, kutsho uthi awunako nokucinga ngokurekhoda ividiyo yayo.
eng_text: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Ukuba usebenzisa i-drone, khangela kuselithuba ukuba yintoni na okuvumeleke ukuba uyifote nokuba ithini imithetho okanye ilayisenisi efunekayo.
eng_text: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Ukubhabhisa i-drone ngakwisikhululo senqwelo moya okanye phezu kwabantu abaninzi iphantse ihlale ilicebo elibi, noba umthetho wasemgingqini yakho awukwaleli.
eng_text: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Kule mihla, uhambo ngenqwelo moya alufane lubhukishwe ngokuthe ngqo ngaphandle kokuqala kuthelekiswe amaxabiso.
eng_text: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Ngamanye amaxesha inqwelomoya efanayo inokuba namaxabiso ahluke kakhulu kubahlanganisi abahlukeneyo kwaye kuyabhatala ukuthelekisa iziphumo kunye nokujonga kwiwebhusayithi yenqwelomoya ngokwayo ngaphambi kokubhukisha.
eng_text: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Nangona ungenoyidinga i-Visa xawuvakashele ixesha elincinci kwamanye amazwe njengomvakashi okanye kwezoshishini, ukuya pha njengomfundi wezwe lonke kudlango dinga umntu ahlale kade kunomntu ovakishele ulonwabo.
eng_text: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Ngokuqhelekileyo, xa uza kuhlala ixesha elide kwilizwe lasemzini kuye kufuneke ufumane i-visa kwangaphambili.
eng_text: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Ii-visa zabafundi zinezinto ezifunekayo neendlela zokuyibhalisela ezahlukileyo kwezo zevisa yokukhenketha okanye yomsebenzi.
eng_text: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Emazweni amanintsi, uyakudinga ileta esukaa kwisikolo onqwenela ukufunda kuso, kwaye nobungqina bobukho bemali yokuzixhasa kangangonyaka wokuqala wezifundo zakho.
eng_text: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Qinisekisa kwizikoo, futhi nakwisebe lokufika kwabantu bamanye amazwe lelilizwe obawela ukufunda kulo ukuze ufumane iinkcukacha zeemfaneleko.
eng_text: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Ngaphandle kokuba ungunozakuzaku, xa uphangela kwelinye ilizwe, oko kuthetha ukuba kuza kufuneka ufake amaxwebhu erhafu kwilizwe ophangela kulo.
eng_text: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Irhafu yengeniso ilungelelaniswe ngeendlela ezingafaniyo kumazwe ahlukahlukeneyo, yaye amazinga erhafu kunye nengeniso echatshazelwa ngawo iyahluka kakhulu ngokwahlukana kwamazwe.
eng_text: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Kumanye amazwe efederal, njenge United States ne Canada, itax yenzuzo itsalwa kubini kwizinga le federal nakwelasekuhlaleni, ngoko ubungakanani bungashiyana ukuya kwingingqi ngengingqi.
eng_text: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Ngelixa ukutshekishwa kudla ngokungabikho okanye isiqhelo xa ufika kwilizwe lakho, ulawulo lwe-customs luba yingxaki.
eng_text: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Qinisekisa ukuba uyazi ukuba ungangenisa ntoni kwaye awunako ukuzisa ubhengeze nantoni na ngaphezulu komda osemthethweni.
eng_text: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Indlela elula yokuqala ishishini lakho lokubhala ngokhenketho kukuba ulole izakhono zakho kwi webhusaythi okanye iblog esele izinzile.
eng_text: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Emva kokuba ukhululekile ngokufomatha kunye nokuhlela kwiwebhu, emva koko unokwenza iwebhusayithi yakho.
eng_text: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Ukuvolontiya ngelixa undwendwela yindlela entle yokwenza umahluko kodwa ayikokunikela nje kuphela.
eng_text: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Ukuhlala uvolontiye kwelinye ilizwe yindlela entle yokwazi isithethe esahlukileyo, ubone abantu abatsha, ufunde ngawe, ufumane imbono kwaye ufuname nezakhono ezitsha.
eng_text: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Ingayindlela entle yokwenza imali yakho ingakhawulezi iphele ize ikuvumele uhlale kuloo ndawo ekubeni imisebenzi emininzi yamatsha-ntliziyo iye ibonelele ngendawo yokuhlala yaye eminye embalwa iye ibhatale nomvuzo omncinci.
eng_text: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: IiVikings zasebenzisa imilambo yaseRashiya ukuze zibuyele kuLwandle Olumnyama nakuLwandle lwe-Caspian. Iinxalanye zezi ndlela zingasetyenziswa. Jonga ukuba kuyimfuneko ukuba neepemithi, zona ekusenokuba nzima ukuzifumana.
eng_text: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: I White Sea–Baltic Canal idibanisa i-Arctic Ocean ukuya kwi Baltic Sea, nge-Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, ikakhulu ngemilambo namachweba.
eng_text: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: I Lake Onega iqhakamishelalana ne Volga, ngoko ke xa usuka kulwandle I Caspiam uhamba nge Russia kusenokwazeka.
eng_text: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Qinsekisa ukuba ukhe wachana i-marians yonke into iyakube sele icacile. Uyakudibana nesinye isikhitshane sabahayikhayo kwaye bayakwabelana nawe ngeenkcukacha zabo.
eng_text: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Ngokuyintloko uza kubeka izaziso ezichaza into ofuna ukuyenza, uhamba hambe edokisini, uye ebantwini abacoca izikhephe zabo, uzame ukuqhagamshelana noomatiloshe ebharini, njl, njl.
eng_text: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Zama ukuncokola nabantu abaninzi kangangoko. Emva kwexesha elithile wonke umntu uza kukwazi aze akunike amacebiso malunga nesikhephe esikhangela umntu.
eng_text: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Kufuneka ukhethe inqwelo moya ekwindibaniselwano Ohamba Ngayo rhoqo ngobunono.
eng_text: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Nangona unokucinga ukuba kuyinto enomdla ukujoyina inqwelo moya moya ohamba ngayo rhoqo, kuya kufuneka wazi ukuba amalungelo anikezelwayo ahlala ahlukile kwaye amanqaku okuhamba rhoqo kungenzeka angcono kwenye inqwelo moya ekwindibaniselwano enye.
eng_text: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Iinqwelomoya ezinjenge Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways neTurkish Airlines zandise kakhulu iinkonzo zazo eAfrika, noqhakamshelwano kwizixeko ezininzi zase Afrika ngamaxabiso akhuphisana nayo kunezinye inwelomoya zase Europe.
eng_text: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: I-Turkish Airlines iya kwiindawo eziyi-39 kumazwe aseAfrika ayi-30 ukususela ngo-2014.
eng_text: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Ukuba unexesha elongezelelekileyo lokukhenketha khangela ukuba ikowuti yakho epheleleyo yokuya e Afrika ukuthelekise neferi yokuhamba ihlabathi .
eng_text: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Ungalibali ukongeza kwiindleko ezongezelelekileyo zeevisa, ezothutho, ezothutho emhlabeni, njl.njl. Kuzo zonke ezo ndawo zingaphandle kweAfrika.
eng_text: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Ukuba ufina ukundiza kwihlabathi liphela kumazantsi e Hemisphere, ukhetho lwenqwelomoya nendawo ezifikelela kuzo ziyabaleka ngenxa yokunqongophala kwendlela ezigudla unxweme.
eng_text: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Akukho mbutho wenqwelo moya endiza phezukwazo zontathu iindlela zogqitha emZantsini Wehlabathi (futhi i-SkyTeam ayogqumi nenye indlela yokugqitha).
eng_text: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Kodwa ke, I star Alliance iquka yonke into ngaphandle ko Mzantsi Mpuma Pacific osuka e Santiago de Chile ukuya Tahiti, eyi LATAM Oneworld flight.
eng_text: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Isindizi asisiso sodwa ukhetho ukuba ufuna ukweqa i-Mzantsi Pacific elunxwemeni olubucala ngasekunene.
eng_text: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Ngo-1994, eyayingeyase-Armenia i-Nagorno-Karabakh inginqgi ye-Azerbaijan yaqala imfazwe nama-Azeris.
eng_text: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Ngokuxhaswa yiArmenia, iriphablikhi entsha yayilwa. Sekunjalo, akukho lizwe - kuquka neArmenia - elilijonga njengelisemthethweni.
eng_text: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Ingxoxo ezikrelekrele kulommandla ziyaqhubeka ukwenza bhetele ubudlelwane phakathi kwe Armenia ne Azerbaijan.
eng_text: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: I-Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) yeyaziwayo yango 17th-century district erhangqwe i-Binnenstad yase-Amsterdam.
eng_text: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Wonke lo mmandla ubizwa ngokuba yi-UNESCO World Heritage Site ngenxa yokukhetheka kwenkcubeko kunye nembali yayo, kwaye amaxabiso epropathi aphakathi kwawona aphezulu elizweni.
eng_text: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: ICinque Terre, okuthetha imihlaba emihlanu, iquka iilali ezintlanu ezingaselunxwemeni zaseRiomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza naseMonterosso ezikummandla wase-Italiya iLiguria.
eng_text: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Zibhaliwe ku-Ludwe le-Lifa Lemveli lwe-UNESCO.
eng_text: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Ukutyhubela iinkulungwane, abantu bakha ngononophelo ukwakha amathambeka kwindawo emxinwa, enamatye de aya kuthi xhaxhe ngakwelwandle.
eng_text: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Enye enconywayo kukungaveli kophuhliso lwezamashishini ayo. Iindlela, oololiweo, nezikhephe zihlanganisa iilali, futhi iimoto azikwazi ukufikelela zivela ngaphandle.
eng_text: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Indidi zesiFrentshi ezithethwa e Belgium nase Switzerland ziyohluka kancinci kwisiFrentshi esithethwa eFrance, nangona ziyelelene ngokwaneleyo ngokude zifane nokuthi yintethonye.
eng_text: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Ngokukodwa, indlela yokubala yabantetho isisiFrench abahlala eBelgium naseSwitzerland inendawana ezinobucukubhede ezahlukileyo kwisiFrench esithethwa eFrance, nendlela yokubizwa kwamagama ithande ukwahluka.
eng_text: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Nangona kunjalo, bonke abantu abathetha isiFrentshi baseBelgium nabaseSwitzerland ngebefunde isiFrentshi esisesikolweni, ke baya kuba nakho ukukuqonda nokuba usebenzisa inkqubo yokubala yaseFransi esemgangathweni.
eng_text: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Kwiindawo ezininzi zehlabathi, ukubulisa ngesandla emoyeni lonto ibonisa ububele, ubonisa u- "molo."
eng_text: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Sekunjalo, eMalaysia, phakathi kwabantu basezilalini baseMalaysia, ithetha ukuthi “yiza apha,” ngokufanayo nomnwe ogotyiweyo wajonga emzimbeni noluphawu olusetyenziswa kwamanye amazwe aseNtshona, yaye lumele lusetyenziselwe loo njongo kuphela.
eng_text: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Ngokufanayo, umhambi wase-Bhritane oseSpain unokubhidanisa ukuphakanyiswa kwesandla ubhabhayisa usijongise kuwe (kunokuba usijongise kulo mntu ubhekisa kuwe) kube ngathi uza kubuya.
eng_text: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Iilwimi ezincedisayo ziilwimi ezenziweyo okanye ezakhiweyo ezenziwe ngeenjongo zokuncedisana nonxibelelwano phakathi kwabantu abanokuthi babenobunzima ekunxibelelaneni.
eng_text: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Ohlukile kunamazwi adumileyo, amalwimi ayindalo okanye ulwimi olu-organic aphetha ebalulwimi olelona elidumileyo ngenxa yezizathu ezithile njengendlela yokuncokola kwabantu abathetha amalwimi ohlukileyo.
eng_text: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Xa kushushu kakhulu, abahambi bangabona imbonakalo engathi ngamanzi (okanye ezinye izinto).
eng_text: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Ezi zingayingozi ukuba umhambi uleqa umbono, adlale ngamandla futhi namanzi aseleyo.
eng_text: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Nezona ntlango zitshisayo zingabanda kakhulu ebusuku. I Hupothermia ngowona mngcipheko xa kungekho mpahla ishushu.
eng_text: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Ngakumbi, ehlotyeni, kuya kufuneka ujonge iingcongconi ukuba uthatha isigqibo sokunyuka kwi-rainforest.
eng_text: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Nokuba uqhuba kwihlathi elinethropikhi, imizuzwana embalwa uvule iingcango ngelixa ungena ngaphakathi kwisithuthi lixesha elaneleyo lokuba iingcongconi zingene emotweni kunye nawe.
eng_text: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Iflu yentaka, okanye eyakusakuba yi avian ifluenza, ingosulela intake kuquka nabantu.
eng_text: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Zingaphantsi kwewaka iimeko ezixeliweyo ebantwini, kodwa ezinye zazo ziye zabulala.
eng_text: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Abantu abaninzi bebesebenza ngeenkukhu, kodwa ukho umngcipheko kwabanye abathanda ukubuka iintaka.
eng_text: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Ngokwesiqhelo eNorway zi-fjords ezinzulu kunye neentlambo ezingena ngequbuliso kwindawo eneentaba nemihlaba ethe tyaba.
eng_text: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Ezi ndawo ziphakamileyo kudla ngokuthiwa “zii-vidde” into ethetha indawo evulekileyo, engenamithi nengenasiphelo.
eng_text: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: E-Rogaland naseAgder zihlala zibizwa ngokuba yi "hei" okuthetha ukuba awunampilo ye-moorland ehlala igutyungelwe yiheather.
eng_text: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Imisinga yomkhence ayizinzanga, kodwa yehla entabeni. Oku kuya kubangela ukuqhekeka, amaqula, anokuthi angabonakali ngenxa yeebhlorho zekhephu.
eng_text: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Indonga namaphahla emiqolomba yomkhenkce angawa zize nentanda zivaleke.
eng_text: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Eziphelweni zekhephu, iindawo ezinkulu ziyaqhekeka, ziwe zize zitsibe okanye ziqengqelelkele kude nesiphelo.
eng_text: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Ixesha labakhenkethi kwizikhululo ezikwiinduli lidla ngokunyuka kakhulu ngexesha lasehlotyeni.
eng_text: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Nangona, zinodidi olwahlukileyo lobuhle nomtsalane ngexesha lasebusika, nezitishi zentatyana ezinintsi zifumana umlinganiselo ofanelekileyo wekhephu ibe inikezela ngolwabo olufana nokubhabha nokutshibiliza kwikhephu.
eng_text: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Zimbalwa kakhulu inqwelomoya ezisanikeza ngamaxabiso okuswelekelwa, athi ophulele kancinane indleko zokundwendwela ngomzuzu wokugqibela wokuya kungcwaba.
eng_text: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Iinqwelo-moya ezibonelela ngezi ziquka i-Air Canada, i-Delta Air Lines, i-Lufthansa yeenqwelo-moya ezivela e-US okanye Canada nase WestJet.
eng_text: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Ngawo onke amaxesha, umele ubhukishe ngokuthe ngqo kwi-airline.
eng_text: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
